why_made: A single saturated red against warm-black surfaces with consistent 24px-radius cards; pricing contrast of white vs dark card is clear and honest.
watch_out: Dark red-black surfaces with low-contrast grey body copy turn muddy if the accent is spread beyond buttons.

name: Fabrica Partners

type.note: Serif statement paired with grotesk links

thesis: A one-screen holding page: a single 3D logomark, one serif sentence and two links, with the background slowly shifting between warm and cool tints.
why_made: Everything is cut except the mark and one sentence, so the scale, kerning and centred axis carry the quality; the background tint drift gives life without any extra elements.
watch_out: With no content to hide behind, a weak logo render, tight tracking errors or a harsh tint shift would show immediately.

name: SERY*

type.note: Mono-weight grotesk labels, huge WORK title

thesis: A black work index where varied client imagery is the colour and tiny captions carry all structure.
why_made: Cases are cropped at mixed ratios in a tight 2-column grid with uniform micro-captions, so the black frame lets very different brands sit together.
watch_out: Without strong, consistent photography the black grid reads as a bare list.

name: Kvadrat

type.note: Single family throughout

thesis: A textile brand that lets one saturated cobalt fabric photograph fill the screen under a minimal white utility header.
why_made: The cobalt image is the only colour, cropped almost full-width inside a white frame, so product colour is the brand.
watch_out: Without exceptional colour photography, a plain white frame plus one image feels empty.

name: Patagonia

type.note: Tight tracked display

thesis: An outdoor retailer organised as a magazine of full-bleed action photos with category shelves under them.
why_made: Real, imperfect action photography, consistent 8px radius cards and a clear footer values band make commerce feel editorial.
watch_out: Stock outdoor shots and tight 64px type would feel generic without Patagonia's authentic imagery.

name: SILENCIO

type.note: Thin giant caps against tiny mono

thesis: A pale studio room where floating white packaging objects hover, with huge thin type behind them.
why_made: The monochrome grey palette and rendered pack shots make a single material world, with extreme scale contrast between 141px thin type and 9px mono labels.
watch_out: Hairline display and 9px mono labels break at small sizes or low contrast.

name: Vivien's Creative

type.note: Serif intro above grotesk wordmark

thesis: A talent-agency homepage that is one huge wordmark across the bottom over a rapidly cross-fading slideshow of artist photographs.
why_made: Wall-to-wall editorial photography with a clipped white wordmark and one serif line is fashion-magazine confident and has no UI chrome; cross-dissolves with wipes feel curated.
watch_out: Weak or mismatched photography collapses the effect; the text must keep contrast over bright skies.

name: Camille Mormal

type.note: Minimal text

thesis: A photographer's dark portfolio: an intro collage that resolves into a horizontal film-strip of portrait tiles with a counter.
why_made: Near-black ground, uniform tile height and tiny counters let the colour-graded photography do the work; the intro collage settles into the strip.
watch_out: Poorly graded or inconsistent photos would look dull on this black.

name: The Marshall Project

type.note: Serif headlines, mono-ish red kickers

thesis: A news nonprofit site that stacks photo-led lead stories over a dense, well ordered feed with one red action colour.
why_made: Strict type system (Miller, Utopia, caps kicker) and a single hot red for donate/sign-up give a disciplined editorial hierarchy.
watch_out: Dense lists need exact spacing and consistent thumbnails or they become clutter.

name: Patrick Heintzmann

type.note: All mono

thesis: A developer-artist portfolio as a typed document: index numbers, metadata blocks and a video thumbnail per project.
why_made: Single mono font, left index column and strict metadata (ROLE, CLIENT, YEAR, TECH, AWARDS) read like a spec sheet; project videos animate.
watch_out: All-mono at 12px wears out readers unless leading and column widths are held tight.

name: Parsley Health

type.note: Light serif headline over humanist sans

thesis: A telehealth membership site that uses warm portraiture, a light serif and deep green pills to feel clinical but human.
why_made: Teodor light headlines over a peach-to-sand photo field, pill buttons in one deep green and consistent 12-16px radii give a calm medical-wellness tone.
watch_out: Light serifs over photography lose contrast; sticky pill plus popup may nag.

name: Lightspeed

type.note: Wordmark in a serif (Lightspeed), 10-12px uppercase labels

thesis: A VC firm site that treats founders' portraits as the hero, scattered over a cream page that dissolves into a sky-blue gradient as you scroll.
why_made: Two-colour world (cream and sky blue) with warm portrait backgrounds as the only saturated content; a single thin sans at one weight keeps it calm; blurred-text scroll transitions feel physical.
watch_out: Without the real portrait art direction and the soft vertical gradient, the scattered layout reads as a random collage.

name: Wecraft Media

type.note: Poppins and Raleway sneak in for fragments

thesis: A software studio site with a floating pill nav, soft tiled backdrop and a restrained blue accent.
why_made: Consistent 20px/16px radii, neutral greys and one electric blue accent; case-study rows with tidy meta chips are easy to scan.
watch_out: Generic Framer template feel; stock team photos and tiny logo wall flatten the identity.

name: Ponpon Mania

type.note: Almost all communication is illustration

thesis: A fully illustrated storybook hero where a layered sunset scene with characters is the entire interface.
why_made: Layered flat vector art with a limited saturated palette (periwinkle, orange, pink, green) and tiny UI that stays out of the art's way.
watch_out: Needs a real illustrator; any stock mascot art makes it childish.

name: Voice Tag Gods

type.note: Mixes bold wide display with italic lines

thesis: A marketplace for producer voice tags using wide heavy type, floating avatar chips and a pill-glass nav on pale grey.
why_made: Tight leading and hard negative tracking on a wide variable face makes headlines read as a brand; featured vocalist card has real photography with a player.
watch_out: The capture is mostly empty; extreme -8px tracking breaks at small sizes.

name: Poeza

type.note: Serif Didone wordmark centred as the only flourish

thesis: A bridal label site that is almost entirely white page, one sharp editorial photograph at a time and tiny caps text.
why_made: Extreme restraint: a single typeface, three neutrals, enormous uppercase headlines against 12px captions, and photography with real art direction (soft grey backdrops, tonal gowns).
watch_out: With weaker photography or crowded text this becomes an empty white page.

name: RJ Plus Accounting Consultant

type.display: Geist, 64px/64px, 600, -1px with Instrument-style italic serif accent words
type.note: Italic serif highlights ('Wealth & Business Growth')

thesis: A professional-services site with a glass card over architectural photography and an italic serif accent.
why_made: Italic serif inside a sans headline adds warmth; consistent 16-24px radii and warm photography make accounting feel personal.
watch_out: Glass card on busy photo can hurt legibility; icon-in-pill tags look template.

name: Potrero

type.note: Orange #ff4a1c micro-labels

thesis: A Montevideo creative studio on pure black with a gigantic wordmark, orange micro-labels and floating project images.
why_made: Hard black, one orange accent, monster wordmark that locks to viewport width; floating project thumbnails with 'VIEW' cursor pills feel tactile.
watch_out: Black plus giant type is easy to imitate badly; mockup-laptop thumbnails look dated.

name: Little Troop

type.note: Tiny 10-11px meta labels

thesis: A design studio portfolio with a spinning 3D toy sphere hero and tilted full-bleed project cards over white.
why_made: Strong, specific art: each project is shown as tilted, full-bleed object with oversized dancing type; the UI is almost invisible.
watch_out: Needs ownable art and 3D; tilted images without that polish look chaotic.

name: Stripe Blog

type.note: Headlines navy #0a2540, body slate

thesis: A blog index laid out as an editorial ledger with metadata columns on dashed grid lines and generated hero art cards.
why_made: Strict 4-column structure and hairline guides, one variable font at fine weights, consistent author/date metadata; art cards are gradient-rich yet on-brand.
watch_out: Without the custom art system, the same layout would be dry.

name: La Dolfina Jumping

type.note: Gold-ish #c8b98a accents

thesis: An equestrian brand in navy with letterspaced classical caps, offset photos and a monogram watermark.
why_made: Palette discipline (navy, white, antique gold) and Roman capitals give old-money tone; staggered offsets of photos feel editorial.
watch_out: Dim, low-contrast body text on navy and many tiny sizes; easy to go costume-y.

name: Sparkle — Stars to Habits

type.display: system sans (SF) up to 245px/850 with italic Iowan serif accent words
type.note: Gold italic serif 'Today.' accent

thesis: A family rewards-app landing with warm gradient scenes, glass UI fragments and a 3D character that changes per chapter.
why_made: Per-chapter background colour shifts (peach, lilac, midnight) and real-looking UI cards give a coherent product story.
watch_out: Many gradients and emoji-adjacent assets can feel kid-app generic.

name: Native Law PLLC

type.note: Gold and navy accent words in headline

thesis: A tribal-law firm site that uses a patterned mandala medallion as the hero mark and navy as brand colour.
why_made: Culturally specific illustrated mandala and woven-pattern footer give identity beyond law-firm stock; consistent navy.
watch_out: WordPress-template body sections and small text keep it below top tier.

name: N26

type.note: Extended grotesk used only for the hero line; UI in the regular cut.

thesis: A full-bleed lifestyle photograph carries a bank, with one centred line and one pill CTA on top.
why_made: One image, one sentence, one button; the nav is a slim white bar so the photo gets all the drama. The teal-to-photo load reveal makes the brand colour the first impression.
watch_out: Without a real, warmly lit, well-cropped photo the centred white text over a darkened image reads like a stock hero.

name: Canopy

type.note: Serif display with italic emphasis word; yellow highlighter marks key word.

thesis: A trust-first crowdfunding-for-lab-tests product wrapped in a warm paper palette, serif headlines and soft blue contour blobs.
why_made: The warm cream surface, navy ink and single yellow highlighter give a consumer-health site credibility without looking clinical. Real product cards with progress bars show the actual mechanism early.
watch_out: Serif plus rounded sans plus blobs can slide into a generic startup-editorial look if the contour shapes aren't tied to the product.

name: Villa Aurelia

type.display: Cormorant Garamond, 220px max (hero script overlay La Graziela), 600, -8.8px tracking; section heads ~48px 500 with italic second line
type.note: Letterspaced Raleway 11-12px caps for nav and field labels.

thesis: A Turkish boutique hotel presented as a warm-paper editorial with serif/italic headlines, tilted photo cards and a hairline booking form.
why_made: Restraint in colour (cream, espresso, one gold dot) and consistent micro-typography give a luxury register; the eyebrow, serif-plus-italic headline, centred muted body rhythm repeats exactly. Real hotel functions (room tabs, restaurant, booking form) are fully designed.
watch_out: The look relies on strong photography and perfect letterspacing; with weaker imagery or heavier fonts it becomes wedding-invitation kitsch.

name: Cathy Dolle

type.note: Everything is micro 10px; images do the talking.

thesis: A white void with a vertical column of product and object photographs that you scroll through, flanked by tiny index labels.
why_made: Ultra-small type and total white make each photographed object the only colour and form; the index list flanks the column and highlights the current item. Very consistent with the three.js scroll.
watch_out: It works only with a world-class image set and a patient viewer; as a default it hides information and fails on mobile discoverability.

name: Radio Null Rewind 2022

type.note: Fraunces italic for '2022'; marquee ribbon text in caps.

thesis: A playful year-in-review splash with giant marquee type, fluttering butterfly video cutouts and fake OS-style floating cards.
why_made: Strong typographic scale, a tight system of small cards with 8-12px radii and real motion (video butterflies, marquee) give an authored, witty world.
watch_out: Whimsy and cookie-dispenser jokes are brand-specific; reused elsewhere they look like clutter.

name: LEDUP

type.note: Fonts not detected; estimated from frames.

thesis: A Portuguese architectural lighting brand using a taupe-brown palette, rounded stacked panels and large architectural photography.
why_made: Logo-on-black preloader hands off to an image hero cleanly; the brown rounded sheets that stack over the white page give physical depth with minimal means.
watch_out: Soft grey-on-white thin headlines lose contrast and the rounded stacked panels need very accurate easing.

name: Good Design Awards Week

type.note: Single grotesk; all caps display.

thesis: A one-week awards microsite that switches whole-page colour fields between yellow, white and green with black hairlines and a single grotesk.
why_made: A disciplined three-colour system and hairline rules make the loud colour feel organised; everything aligns to one grid.
watch_out: The saturated yellow/green blocks only work with this exact grotesk and rule system; otherwise garish.

name: Noise Studio

type.note: Mono used for credits and nav.

thesis: A commercial director/production reel site where a dark cropped-video grid is the whole interface.
why_made: Edge-to-edge 16:9 video tiles with tiny mono credits make the work the layout; autoplay thumbnails and a bold hero reel keep it cinematic.
watch_out: Dense video grids without credit hierarchy or lazy-loading become sluggish and noisy.

name: Olivier Larose

type.note: Mono for small meta labels.

thesis: A developer portfolio with a quirky mixed-font intro and a dense, tabular project index.
why_made: The project list as a true table with year, role, client and a black inversion on hover is information-dense and exact; the mixed display fonts add personality only in the intro.
watch_out: The index only works with consistent row rhythm and tiny type; sloppy columns turn it into a spreadsheet.

name: GitHub Universe '24

type.note: Path-style headings with trailing slash.

thesis: A conference site dressed as a file system: slash-terminated headings, mono labels and hairline-ruled grid cells on pale sage.
why_made: One idea executed consistently: every section title is a directory path, and every box is ruled with 1px lines; green appears only on CTAs.
watch_out: The terminal conceit becomes gimmicky if applied to a non-developer audience.

name: Pedestal

type.note: Yellow-lime #e8e6ce-adjacent subtitle overlays on film.

thesis: A furniture-accessory shop led by a cinematic short film hero, then category image tiles and an editorial journal.
why_made: The hero film with typed subtitles, big grotesk 'OBJECTS OF DESIRE' and colour-tinted category tiles raise a commodity store to a brand; the dark footer with giant logo grounds it.
watch_out: Lime overlay type on moving video can fail contrast and feel garish without a graded image.

name: The Future Label

type.note: Inter Display secondary

thesis: A single full-bleed architectural film loop carries the whole first screen, with the studio statement set as a plain text block over it.
why_made: One restrained image with warm natural light and a person walking gives life without effects; type is one size, one weight, one column.
watch_out: Over a busy photo the white text loses contrast; a weaker or brighter image makes the page illegible.

name: Delassus

type.display: Sailec UI + condensed 3D lettering as imagery, 16px UI weight 500
type.note: headlines are rendered paper-craft images

thesis: A paper-craft stop-motion story where each full-screen colour world (orange, yellow, mint, salmon) is one fact about an agricultural group.
why_made: Every scene is a single coherent handmade material (paper, shadow, flat colour) so the loud palette feels authored.
watch_out: Without real paper renders the saturated blocks look like a children's site; it also hides content inside a slideshow.

name: Apple MacBook Pro

type.note: orange 12px eyebrow for 'New'

thesis: A two-model comparison on pure black where each column is centred product shot, name, one-liner, price, and two clear actions.
why_made: Rigid vertical rhythm, one blue accent, real financing numbers set as plain centred text, and generous black space make the buying decision effortless.
watch_out: Copying the black plus pills without Apple's product photography and strict spacing looks bare; legal footnote blocks need hierarchy.

name: The Warren

type.note: terracotta accent

thesis: A warm cream and black marketing site whose thumbprint line pattern and rabbit mascot give a boutique growth agency a personality.
why_made: Consistent 12px-radius cards, a single terracotta accent and alternating cream/black sections give clear rhythm.
watch_out: Small 12-13px body text on cream gets low contrast; card grids can slide into template look.

name: Blandina Manifesto

type.note: capture mostly dark

thesis: A black intro rotates keywords before a scroll opens a full-bleed orange yoga photograph with an offset manifesto text.
why_made: The reveal from black to a saturated orange image is a strong contrast moment, and wide-tracked small caps look deliberate.
watch_out: Mostly black in capture; relying on scripted reveals means empty screens if they stall.

name: Flavor Dady

type.note: maroon and cream

thesis: A friendly drinks brand site using a maroon and cream palette, rounded type and a character mascot to sell a range of bottles.
why_made: Tight palette discipline (maroon, cream, product colours) and consistent rounded radii keep a playful brand coherent.
watch_out: Rounded fonts plus cartoon illustration go childish if the product photography is weak.

name: The Aviator (EPIC)

type.note: tiny uppercase labels

thesis: A grey-paper agency site where a red hero car, a sentence that bends along a scrolling curve, and an illustrated balloon scene replace typical sections.
why_made: Mixing a high-contrast didone with 11px labels and hairline rules is consistently editorial, and each section carries a different mechanic.
watch_out: Large moving type is easy to make unreadable; grey on grey gets flat.

type.note: entire site is monospace micro type

thesis: A catalog of digital design assets presented as a numbered specimen grid where every item is a bordered cell with an index and label.
why_made: One mono face, 1px hairlines, 8px radii and uniform cells make the whole page feel like a measured instrument; each tile previews the actual component.
watch_out: Without real, well-drawn previews the empty cells read as a blank wireframe; the micro type is hard to read below 11px.

name: Royal College of Art

type.note: red-orange accent

thesis: A black institutional site alternating dark panels and white blocks with large photographs and a visible column grid.
why_made: Confident black and white with one red-orange accent and big photography; the grid lines show structure.
watch_out: Heavy black can feel gloomy and the mid-scroll sections can look unfinished if photos are weak.

name: Monet 100

type.note: counter numerals as hero

thesis: A year-count tribute where a giant serif numeral rolls like an odometer over a painterly dark sepia field.
why_made: A single typographic object, one warm palette and the painterly texture give a museum mood.
watch_out: Single-screen concept; without more content it is just a counter.

name: Anime.js

type.note: each feature gets its own colour

thesis: A scroll-driven ring HUD where a central circle shows live demos of each library feature and morphs through 3D object scenes.
why_made: Strong system: one ring, one code snippet block, one timeline scrub, colour-coded per feature.
watch_out: Heavy WebGL and per-section colours are hard to reuse and can hurt performance.

name: Angelo

type.note: all UI minuscule

thesis: A single white screen showing a floating cluster of glossy project spheres around a violet core, with only a Let's talk button.
why_made: Radical restraint: one object, soft glows, tiny footer UI with a black pill.
watch_out: Zero visible content beyond spheres; unusable if users can't tell they are clickable.

name: Deadstock Coffee

type.note: slanted display face only for brand moments

thesis: A streetwear-flavoured coffee shop that uses one hot yellow and a huge italic wordmark against white and near-black.
why_made: One accent yellow is used in blocks, buttons and a ticker, and everything else is white or black, so the brand reads instantly; real product and people photography carries the rest.
watch_out: The italic display type and yellow only work with confident photography and tight copy; with stock imagery it turns into a merch template.

name: Zentry

type.display: ZentryScreamer condensed black, up to 162px, 900, tracking ~-0.1px
type.note: tiny mono body against huge condensed caps

thesis: A web3 brand site using a custom condensed display face, lavender panels and 3D-rendered objects revealed by scroll.
why_made: Extreme scale contrast between 160px condensed caps and 9-12px mono, plus a consistent lavender/violet palette and rendered objects, gives a distinctive identity.
watch_out: Tiny mono copy and empty placeholder panels hurt legibility; the style needs custom type and real 3D assets to avoid looking like a gimmick.

name: Fellow

type.note: geometric display with neutral grotesk body

thesis: Premium coffee-gear store led by styled tabletop photography, with a branded newsletter modal at first load.
why_made: Photography is art-directed on warm neutrals with dark objects, and the UI stays minimal black pills and hairlines so products carry the page.
watch_out: The capture is dominated by a modal; heavy popups on load would undercut the quiet premium feel.

name: Notion About

type.note: tight display, calm body

thesis: A long-form company story told with black ink line illustrations and archival photos on pure white.
why_made: Illustrations share one stroke weight and one palette, the text column is narrow and quiet, and everything sits on a strict two-column grid with very generous whitespace.
watch_out: Without a bespoke illustration set the white page would look empty; the blue CTA is the only colour so it must stay singular.

name: Maximize

type.note: mono labels like OUR(SERVICES)

thesis: A growth agency for dev tools with cream paper, dithered orange-blue isometric blocks and code-syntax headings.
why_made: The gradient-grain isometric artwork gives a strong ownable image, and cream plus black section swaps create clear rhythm.
watch_out: Dither gradients and code jokes are easy to overdo; the floating glass nav overlaps content in places.

name: Plumeform

type.note: serif accent Instrument Serif

thesis: A survey builder on deep teal-black that hands off to a cream product panel with a live dashboard.
why_made: Dark-to-light handoff, glowing mint edge on the product frame and tight display type feel polished and consistent.
watch_out: Aurora glow and neon border can look generic if not tied to product colours.

name: Felix Haas
thesis: A personal letter set as a single quiet column with a pinned label and soft fade at the edges.
why_made: One type family, one column and a pinned sticky title make reading effortless and personal.
watch_out: Without strong writing and a scroll-edge fade this is just an empty page; the pinned label overlaps body text mid-scroll.

name: KenzieFrakerDesign

type.display: Instrument Sans 52px/62px 600 mixed with Instrument Serif italic
type.note: italic serif emphasis word inside sans heading

thesis: A subscription design studio page with a ring of floating work thumbnails and italic-serif accent words.
why_made: Italic serif emphasis on single words, a clear section sequence and a real work grid keep a simple white page feeling designed.
watch_out: Italic emphasis on every heading becomes a tic; work thumbnails need consistent quality.

name: Diamonds Re

type.note: light weight display

thesis: An Italian property consultancy on navy and white with full-bleed architectural photography.
why_made: Restrained navy and white, consistent 24px radii, and warm editorial photography feel like a premium advisory brand.
watch_out: Navy plus light Poppins is common; photography quality does the work.

name: STILL / FORM

type.note: large numerals 01-06 for steps

thesis: A residence presentation that runs from a warm cream intro to a blue wireframe 3D house explored by scroll.
why_made: Strong palette switch from cream to cobalt, consistent numbered HUD and a real scroll-driven model give clear narrative.
watch_out: The blueprint 3D section needs a real model; otherwise it looks empty.

name: Money in Check

type.note: scroll-lit text goes grey to black

thesis: A book site on a faint grid with hand-scribbled green marks and large serif statements that darken as you scroll.
why_made: The grid paper, margin scribbles and scroll-activated word highlight make an ownable bookish tone.
watch_out: Low contrast grey text and a fully empty first screen cost clarity.

name: Structure Consulting Engineers

type.text: PP Fraktion Mono 13-16px uppercase labels, Sequel Sans 16-20px body
type.note: Mono for all UI and long copy, grotesk for statements; olive-yellow contact block as the one colour moment.

thesis: An engineering firm presented as an architecture-grade photo journal, with a mono interface layer over big project photography.
why_made: Type pairing is rigid and consistent: mono for every label, button and paragraph, grotesk only for statements. Real project photography carries the hero and the colour is restricted to one olive block.
watch_out: Mono body copy at small size over photos turns illegible and gimmicky without the scrim and strict size discipline.

name: Alessandro Stella, Art Direction & Design Consultancy

type.text: Garamond Premier Pro Caption 15px, italics for descriptors
type.note: One serif at one size; hierarchy only by roman vs italic and grey.

thesis: A portfolio reduced to one centered image at a time and two lines of caption, letting the work carry everything.
why_made: The restraint is absolute: single typeface, single size, hairline rules, off-white ground and generous margins, so the art direction work is the only decoration. Every spacing is consistent and nothing is boxed.
watch_out: Without world-class imagery and exact centering this becomes an empty, slow template.

name: MVRDV

type.note: Condensed uppercase on photography, regular DIN on white statement bands.

thesis: A scroll of full-viewport project images alternated with white statement bands, each ending in an outlined arrow button.
why_made: Strong rhythm of image then white band then image; condensed uppercase DIN titles are scaled to fill the frame width. Colour comes entirely from the photography and diagrams.
watch_out: Condensed type at 170px over busy photos loses legibility without the contrast and consistent bottom-left anchoring.

name: New York Phil

type.note: Condensed uppercase headlines against editorial serif body.

thesis: A concert hall brand run as a bold colour system: condensed caps on yellow, magenta, cyan and teal blocks, with documentary photography in black and white.
why_made: A consistent system of colour blocks, huge condensed type and monochrome photography gives a strong identity for a content-heavy site. Cards are uniform and event metadata is tidy.
watch_out: Four saturated blocks plus black on one page is chaotic unless one block system and one type voice are held strictly.

name: Ян Козлов

type.note: Tight-tracked light display with black pill-ish buttons; Cyrillic set cleanly.

thesis: A solo therapist's site built as a black and white Framer layout with real portraits, service pricing and FAQ.
why_made: Content is well structured for a practitioner: services, pricing, credentials, FAQ. Alternating white and near-black sections with identical row layouts keep it coherent.
watch_out: Black and white alone feels generic; the human photography is what makes it work.

name: Brand Designer for B2B SaaS, Fintech & Tech Startups

type.note: Orange accent word inside headline.

thesis: A freelance brand designer's one-page offer: productized pricing, work wall, process and one CTA.
why_made: Clear sales structure with fixed-price offer cards and one vivid orange accent over warm cream. Imagery of real brand work does the selling.
watch_out: Many pill chips and cream cards read as a Framer template if the portfolio imagery is weak.

name: Quynh Folio

type.note: Mono metadata plus Helvetica; orange marker for active item.

thesis: A portfolio built as an instrument: radial clock dial on the left, a single project image deck on the right.
why_made: One compositional idea executed with precision: split screen, dial ticks, mono labels and a rotating deck, and a rust-orange transition.
watch_out: Sound gate, black preloader and dial interactions get in the way for anyone who wants to see work fast.

name: LaCrapule Studio

type.note: Brand titles as huge bold white wordmarks over imagery.

thesis: A CGI studio showing its client work as full-screen triptych slides with bold white brand names.
why_made: Content-first: each project is a full-viewport three-panel composition with the brand name and a small control set; interface is minimal.
watch_out: White titles on varied imagery need a consistent scale and enough contrast or they disappear.

name: OREO & BTS - Love Letter Site

type.note: neon sign lettering inside the 3D scene

thesis: A scroll-driven three.js night-city of neon signs that ends in a thank-you message for fans.
why_made: Lighting, scene density and a consistent blue-violet palette make the 3D read as one authored world, and the loader and final UI are branded to match.
watch_out: Without real scene lighting and dense signage the neon would look like a flat sticker pack, and the heavy WebGL costs load time.

name: Eboca Empresas

type.note: yellow CTA used as the single loud colour

thesis: A B2B coffee-machine service page that uses warm cream, one yellow, real photography and illustration to feel friendly yet credible.
why_made: Consistent 16px radii, one accent yellow and honest photography of beans and offices give it personality without noise.
watch_out: The illustrated mascots and sticker badges turn childish if the photography and grid discipline are missing.

name: Desktop.fm

type.note: UI is a tiny OS-style window

thesis: A single screen of grey with a spinning 3D CD and green laser lines, with a Mac-style dialog holding the waitlist CTA.
why_made: Iridescent disc material, restrained grey ground and a tiny native-looking dialog make one idea feel confident.
watch_out: Without the high-quality disc material and a real reason to be one screen, it looks like an empty page.

name: Fishwife

type.note: 20px/300 spaced taglines

thesis: A restaurant homepage that is one full-bleed dusk photograph of the building with a bottom navigation strip.
why_made: A strong golden-hour photo, minimal white type and a single red reservation button make it instantly appetising and local.
watch_out: One image carries everything: poor photography or missing menu and hours below the fold would look empty.

name: Design Museum

type.note: text sits on yellow highlighter blocks

thesis: A museum site where full-bleed exhibition photography carries headlines set on acid-yellow highlighter strips.
why_made: The yellow highlight system is a distinct ownable device and works on any photo; DIN keeps it institutional.
watch_out: Highlight strips need strict line-by-line rendering; messy padding or unreadable overlaps look amateur.

name: Ability Solutions

type.note: navy, orange, pink and violet block palette

thesis: A disability-services nonprofit that uses real smiling photography, rounded cards and a vivid navy-orange-pink palette.
why_made: Real people photography and consistent 16-20px rounded cards in strong flat colours make it warm and organised.
watch_out: Saturated pink and magenta cards can look garish if photo quality or type contrast slips.

name: Hopper

type.note: blue links and pill CTAs

thesis: A consumer travel app homepage with a photographic hero over a search widget and destination deal cards.
why_made: The glass search bar over a warm sunset photo and tight destination cards are clear and conversion-first.
watch_out: Generic once the photography is stock-like and the cards grid is uniform.

name: Belen Jones

type.note: outlined client names behind a 3D box

thesis: A portfolio whose projects are faces of a rotating chrome 3D box over a tinted wall of outlined client names.
why_made: Each project swaps background tint, matched to the artwork, and the layered type wall plus mono microcopy gives it a clear system.
watch_out: The WebGL box and heavy type collide if project imagery is weak, and it is hard to scan.

name: Dialovet

type.note: teal underline accent on key words

thesis: A friendly vet-clinic site in deep teal and white with circular-cropped pet photos and doodle accents.
why_made: Consistent rounded corners (16/100px), one teal and clear service cards give a coherent warm clinic identity.
watch_out: The doodles and paw patterns look cheap if the pet photography is poor.

name: Babylonstoren

type.note: widely spaced 10-12px caps labels

thesis: A Cape Dutch wine-farm and hotel site that lets large editorial photography and a quiet serif lead, with booking surfaced at every turn.
why_made: Restraint: white ground, one sage green, hairlines and uppercase letterspaced links, with every photograph art directed in natural light.
watch_out: The calm only works with exceptional photography and generous whitespace; with generic stock it reads blank and dated.

name: Stark

type.note: Heavy grotesk with mono eyebrows

thesis: An accessibility tool dressed in saturated indigo and warm cream with a yellow highlighter motif on key phrases.
why_made: Two-colour discipline (indigo on cream) with a single yellow marker accent repeated on every heading gives it a recognisable identity; heavy 900 headlines are tight and consistent.
watch_out: Black-weight headlines and highlighter marks turn childish if the palette widens or the highlight is used on body text.

name: Frontend Masters

type.note: Dense dark catalogue

thesis: A dark course catalogue led by instructor photography and horizontally scrolling course rows.
why_made: Real instructor portraits and consistent course art tiles carry the page; hierarchy of rows is clear and information-dense without breaking.
watch_out: Dense dark card rows get noisy if tile art is not consistent in style and scale.

name: Rivian

type.note: Gigantic model names behind cut-out vehicles

thesis: Full-bleed adventure photography and cut-out vehicles slide horizontally beneath enormous model names.
why_made: Giant R1S/R2/R1T type overlapped by the vehicle gives depth without effects; pricing and range stated plainly beneath.
watch_out: Oversized overlap type fails if the cut-out vehicle is not cleanly masked.

name: Rippling

type.note: Plum and orange

thesis: Enterprise HR landing in deep plum, warm greys and a vivid orange CTA.
why_made: Confident plum hero with photographic hand-and-tablet product, rhythm of light/dark bands and strong orange accent.
watch_out: The chat widget and announcement bar clutter the first screen; plum plus orange needs strict restraint.

name: BeReal

type.note: Black stage with candid footage

thesis: A black stage with looping candid footage hero and phone mockups to explain the product.
why_made: Video-first hero with centered two-line claim and lots of black; calm, minimal copy.
watch_out: Pure black with tiny copy leaves pages feeling empty if the imagery is weaker.

name: Thrivent (captured as Thrive Capital)

type.note: Capture is Thrivent, not Thrive Capital

thesis: A friendly financial services page with portraits on coloured panels and clear action to find an advisor.
why_made: Light-weight 54px headline over a row of real advisor photos on pastel panels, red search CTA, clear navy sections.
watch_out: Stock-looking portraits and many small links make it generic.

name: Le Saint Georges

type.note: Brown on white, Swiss hotel

thesis: A Gruyeres hotel site with aerial hero, warm brown palette and generous photo sections for rooms, weddings and restaurant.
why_made: Restrained serif and brown palette with consistent text-plus-photo rhythm and strong food and event imagery.
watch_out: The floating promo popup blocks content on every frame; low-contrast buttons.

name: Concertgebouw

type.note: Burgundy and warm grey

thesis: A concert hall site where search, date and concert matchmaker are the first thing a visitor meets.
why_made: Task-first hero with two white rounded cards, one burgundy accent and a consistent pill system; footer has a curved dark band.
watch_out: Hero in this capture is washed out white-on-white; the lack of imagery is a risk.

name: VanMoof

type.note: Neutral grotesque with mono promo strip

thesis: A product-launch page where macro photography of the bike carries the story, with oversized neutral type and a minimal floating nav.
why_made: One huge white 'S6' overlapped by a red tail light on a macro detail photo, nearly no UI, hairline-bordered boxed nav and a single fluorescent-yellow strip as the only colour.
watch_out: Oversized thin type on photography turns weak without a strong, high-contrast hero image.

name: Crescent Dental

type.note: single family; teal highlight word inside navy headings

thesis: A trustworthy clinic site built from real staff photography, teal-and-navy blocks and a booking form that closes every scroll.
why_made: Real team and patient photos with consistent teal/navy accents and a clear call, address and email trio make it credible. Contact and booking are always one step away.
watch_out: Inter-only with small body text and stock-feeling rounded cards turns template-like fast if photos are weak.

name: Terry Ho's Yum Yum

type.note: red, orange and mustard blocks with founder photography and sticker-like script notes

thesis: A founder-led sauce brand that turns the product colour into full-bleed red, orange and mustard sections and puts Terry's face on everything.
why_made: Colour blocks are consistent, the founder cutout footer and gift-box hero give a human, appetising identity. Ties between product shots, food photos and script annotations feel art directed.
watch_out: Saturated blocks plus scattered collage notes become chaotic without strict type hierarchy and generous whitespace.

name: The Boring Blog

type.note: italic red 'not' inserted by typewriter animation

thesis: A quiet cloud-sky hero where a painted grass tuft sits at the bottom and the title types itself and corrects 'not'.
why_made: Soft atmospheric background, a single illustrated element and an editorial serif give a distinctive, calm mood. The typed correction is a witty narrative of the brand name.
watch_out: Nearly empty first screen with tiny UI text; imitation without a strong illustrated asset looks unfinished.

name: Dekmantel

type.note: custom heavy wordmark face, tiny uppercase labels

thesis: A festival and label site run like a dense index: huge custom display type, hairline section rules and photography-first rows of events, mixes and merch.
why_made: Consistent 'title + View all' rule headers, strict photo grids and one custom display face give strong identity. Information density stays navigable.
watch_out: Many small 11-13px labels and overlays like the cookie box make it feel cluttered if the grid slips.

name: Footer Design Gallery

type.note: UI quiet so thumbnails carry colour

thesis: A neutral white gallery whose only colour comes from the thumbnails of the footers it curates.
why_made: Hairline-bordered 3-up grid, tiny site names with favicons and a restrained top filter bar keep focus on the work. Compact rhythm is consistent.
watch_out: It relies entirely on strong thumbnails; with weak content the grid looks bland.

name: Signal

type.note: heavy headings, plain body

thesis: A friendly privacy app presented with flat pastel blue, lilac and teal illustration panels and a phone mockup.
why_made: One illustration system with consistent colour blocks, rounded cards and generous text columns makes the page cohesive and approachable.
watch_out: Flat pastels with light cards feel generic without the custom illustrations.

name: Garuda 2026: The Locker Room

type.note: gold italic display on maroon-black

thesis: A 3D gallery of 24 illustrated player cards that orbit a trophy, fan into a carousel and scrub along a radial index.
why_made: Single maroon-black scene, a gold trophy centrepiece and a consistent circular dial create a coherent exhibit. Transitions are fluid and motion-blur driven.
watch_out: Heavy WebGL, tiny mono labels and complex navigation fail on slow devices and for plain information.

name: Brandrunnrs

type.note: tight uppercase display with yellow full stop

thesis: A marketing agency for sports coaches in near-black with one yellow, big tight Clash Display and white contrast cards.
why_made: Two-colour discipline (black + #ffd60a), real coach photography in greyscale and clearly structured offers and prices make it persuasive.
watch_out: Tight negative tracking and tiny grey body text lose legibility without the strict contrast.

name: Counter Culture Coffee

type.note: eiko-light serif accents

thesis: A coffee roaster store using full-colour bag packaging as the brand: yellow hero, orange and lilac blocks, blue nav.
why_made: Pack colours drive section colours, product cards are tidy with tasting-strength meters, and trust items sit under the hero.
watch_out: Cookie banner and pop-ups obscured screens; many saturated blocks need the product art to hold together.

name: Fred

type.note: light serif with italic emphasis, grotesk for UI and captions

thesis: A luxury homewares shop where saturated product photography and a light serif do the work inside a near-white, hairline-ruled grid.
why_made: Restraint everywhere except the photographs: one nav, one serif, 1px rules and square-ish buttons. Photo crops and the italic word give personality without decoration.
watch_out: Without excellent colourful photography and exact serif/grotesk pairing, the white minimalism reads empty.

name: Daily

type.note: DM Mono caps carries nav, labels, links and footer; nothing exceeds 48px.

thesis: A deliberately plain infrastructure page: one narrow column where mono punctuation carries the identity, with a single loud magenta strip.
why_made: Slashes, brackets and square bullets form a small consistent notation across nav, labels, links and footer. Spacing and hairlines do all the structuring, with no imagery beyond one dotted sphere.
watch_out: With no images and no type above 48px, the page reads as an unstyled document unless the notation and spacing stay exact.

name: Asana

type.note: H2s 54px/54px weight 300, -1.08px; only one family used across the page.

thesis: Sign-up is the hero, and a wire diagram of people and agents handing off work wraps it, so the product idea becomes the page structure.
why_made: One signature device, thin wires with nodes, runs from the hero into later sections while everything else stays disciplined: light-weight Lausanne, black pills, hairlines, white and #0d0d0d bands.
watch_out: Wires need real routing and tiny detail or they look like clip art around a form, and the fixed 296px agent widget hides content.

name: Ai2

type.note: H2s 61px, -1.83px. Three colours only: cream, deep teal, hot pink.

thesis: A research lab made warm and ownable: deep teal panels with stepped corners interlock with imagery on cream, punctuated by hot pink.
why_made: The stepped shape of the cross logo becomes a system for cards, images and section edges. The three-colour palette is held strictly on every surface.
watch_out: Notches applied at random or mixed with rounded cards look like rendering bugs, so step size must stay fixed.

name: Cascara Cabinet

type.note: Hero H1 is Inter 92/92 regular; IBM Plex Mono caps act as subtitles and side labels.

thesis: A soda brand run as a surreal scrapbook: vintage cut-outs and ink drawings float on pure white around plain typography.
why_made: The collage assets are original and match the can artwork, and the surrounding layout is disciplined white space with black type. Everything loud lives inside the images.
watch_out: Stock cut-outs would kill it, and the hero headline colliding with objects only survives because the art is this strong.

name: InkTree

type.note: Heavy tight serif for every heading; one violet keyword per heading, often with a pen mark.

thesis: A family-archive app softens AI with a bookish serif, pen doodles and ink portraits over pale cards and one violet accent.
why_made: Pen strokes on keywords and ink portraits tie the page to storytelling, and the testimonial and FAQ parts are cleanly systematised. It has more charm than the usual Framer build, though the hero stack is unresolved.
watch_out: A headline over a faded phone mockup reads as a bug, and more doodles than this tip into clutter.

name: Resend

type.note: Section H2s switch to ABC Favorit 56px/67.2px, -2.8px; code in Commit Mono 14px.

thesis: A developer email API presented as a dark luxury object: serif headline, matte 3D renders and real product fragments on pure black.
why_made: Every section opens with a lit sculptural icon and a tightly tracked gradient heading, and all cards share one hairline-plus-top-highlight treatment. Colour appears only as small section-specific glows on an otherwise black page.
watch_out: Without high-end renders and real UI fragments, black plus glow collapses into the generic dark SaaS template.

name: DeepNode AI

type.note: Inter Light throughout; 120px is reserved for stat numerals.

thesis: A crypto-AI network sells itself on glowing purple hardware renders and a blacked-out dashboard on a blue-to-magenta gradient.
why_made: Render quality is high and the dashboard UI is drawn in real detail, and the pinned scroll panel pairs a plain accordion with those screens. Inter Light keeps the neon from turning tacky.
watch_out: Purple neon cubes and coins are the stock crypto look, and the live 'Staked $DN: Error' nav chip shows how fast polish slips.

name: HAY

type.note: No text above 20px apart from the wordmark; photographs provide all the scale.

thesis: A furniture brand home page that behaves like a catalogue spread: art-directed photographs with engraved-style captions and no commerce chrome.
why_made: Type stays at 20px or below, so photographs hold all the scale, and two faces in small tracked caps do everything. Square corners and a flat #f2f2f2 ground keep images unframed.
watch_out: This only works with strong art direction; average images in the same grid make the page look empty.

name: ON Makelaardij & Financieel Advies

type.note: Display at regular weight only; 40px is the section heading size.

thesis: A local estate agent and adviser made to feel like a modern fintech: inset photo slabs, dark petrol panels and one acid-lime accent.
why_made: Real photographs of the city and team, a three-colour system and consistent 4-8px radii with wide gutters lift it above local-business templates.
watch_out: Acid lime works only in tiny doses, and the dark veil on every photo turns muddy if pushed further.

name: Railway Docs

type.note: Serif appears only on the H1; H2s are Inter 32px/600, -0.5px; code in JetBrains Mono.

thesis: A documentation home that feels warm rather than utilitarian: a serif title, tinted line-art route cards and a calm two-part sidebar.
why_made: Ink, grey and borders all carry a slight violet cast on warm grey, and the four line-art cards give the page character at very low contrast. Density is tuned for scanning.
watch_out: Pastel gradient cards turn childish if the line art is coloured more strongly or the gradients get more saturated.

name: Apple Vision Pro

type.text: SF Pro Text, 17px; 21px/29px at 600 for lead copy
type.note: One family; 48px for chapter headings, 24px eyebrows over video.

thesis: A product story told as a long film: a studio portrait, then full-bleed video scenes separated by white pauses and short headlines.
why_made: Almost nothing but media, one type family and two radii, with the photography fading into the page so nothing has a hard edge. Spacing and the sticky product bar keep a 32,700px page legible.
watch_out: The layout depends entirely on cinema-grade footage; with stock video or weak copy it is just big rectangles and grey text.

name: Ring Pop Candy

type.note: Secondary colours green #306a34, lime #bbdd8c, blue

thesis: A confectionery brand site where every collection owns a full-bleed colour field, a giant collection name and a floating product render.
why_made: Each section commits to one saturated colour with a single product object and one huge word, so the rhythm is instantly legible. Photography is cut out and tilted rather than boxed.
watch_out: Without a tight 4-5 colour system and a real product render per field, the colour-blocking reads as a kids' template.

name: Paco Coursey

type.text: Sohne 16px/28px with Newsreader italic 17px for emphasis
type.note: Single weight, single size, hierarchy by colour and italic

thesis: A personal site reduced to one 640px column of prose and a three-column index, where typography alone carries the hierarchy.
why_made: Everything sits on a strict 28px baseline with one size, so it feels engineered, and the single italic serif phrase adds warmth without a second layout idea. Nothing is decorative.
watch_out: Strip the type quality (Sohne, exact leading) and the same layout looks like an unstyled document.

name: Brand Identity School

type.display: Cormorant Garamond 86px/81.7px 600, -1.72px, uppercase mixed with italic
type.note: Oxblood and bone only; engraving-style illustration

thesis: A course waitlist site that uses oxblood-and-bone engraved illustration, a hare and swan mascot pair and a scroll-drawn journey path to sell a design school.
why_made: The two-colour palette is held rigidly and illustration, type and UI chips all share it, so the whole thing reads as one printed object. The scroll path turns a curriculum into a story.
watch_out: Without commissioned-quality engraving art, serif caps on red look like a wedding invite.

name: EconoImpact Africa

type.note: Charcoal hero, cream sections, gold CTA

thesis: A wealth-advisory site for a named founder that alternates charcoal and cream bands and keeps one saturated gold for every CTA.
why_made: A personal portrait hero plus consistent gold pills makes the conversion path obvious, and the serif headings add credibility. Section order follows a clear problem-solution-proof-FAQ logic.
watch_out: Small body text, thin cards and stock imagery start to feel like a generic coach template.

name: ACME

type.note: Grey and white, one burnt orange

thesis: A tableware shop built as a Swiss spec sheet: a 148px wordmark, hairline table grids and a single orange panel.
why_made: Everything is Helvetica on a visible hairline grid, with product data presented like a catalogue table, and only one accent colour ever appears. The restraint reads as confident and expensive.
watch_out: Without exact grid alignment and real product photography the grey monochrome turns into an unfinished wireframe.

name: Gustavo H

type.note: Black with acid green dithered block

thesis: A designer-developer portfolio that sets a huge uppercase headline over a green pixel-dither field and then proves it with photographic case tiles and counters.
why_made: One loud green graphic plus real project photography gives it character, and the stat row and portrait close are tidy. Layout is simple stacked modules.
watch_out: The green dither block is the only identity; without it the page is a standard dark Framer portfolio.

name: The Tie-break

type.note: Navy loader into blurred photo

thesis: A fashion campaign mini-game landing for a co-branded collection, opening on a deep navy loader and then a motion-blurred photo behind an italic serif title.
why_made: The italic serif title over blurred film-grain photography is on-brand for luxury fashion, and the navy loader with a tiny icon is quiet and confident.
watch_out: Heavy blur and grain hide content; if the title is not perfectly legible it just looks out of focus.

name: The Officin

type.note: Serif light display with warm bone bands

thesis: An event and creative studio site that lets cinematic photography carry the page inside a light serif, bone-and-white frame.
why_made: Large framed images with tiny serif captions, generous bands of bone #f5f2ec and no ornament make it feel like a luxury house site. Typography stays light and small.
watch_out: With weaker photography or heavier type the white and bone bands read as an empty template.

name: terrenohotel.com

type.display: WT Central Avenue condensed grotesque, 68px/60px, 700, uppercase, tracking normal
type.note: script accent 'That's It' above headline; PP Monument Extended for labels

thesis: A Mediterranean boutique hotel told through flat saturated colour blocks (lime, tomato red, oxblood) with a vintage script and condensed-caps voice.
why_made: Colour fields swap wholesale per section with a single ink colour, so the palette feels like printed hotel stationery. Real architecture photograph opens the page at full bleed.
watch_out: Most scroll stops captured blank or near-empty; the colour-block approach needs strong type and photography in each block or it reads as empty.

name: Blue Bottle

type.note: all section heads share one uppercase tracked style; no bold anywhere

thesis: A calm gift-season storefront where dark, moody product photography on moss-green and kraft backdrops carries all the brand, and the UI stays almost invisible.
why_made: One restrained type system, hairline outlined buttons, alternating white and #f6f6f4 bands and fully consistent product photography make a dense commerce page feel curated rather than busy.
watch_out: Without art-directed cut-out product photography on matched backdrops, the flat white grid and outline buttons would look unfinished.

name: Custom Multicades

type.note: extended heavy display against small grey Archivo

thesis: A dark red-glow arcade configurator storefront built in Framer with product renders emerging from a crimson gradient.
why_made: Consistent glassy cards with 16-24px radii, a floating pill nav and a single red gradient hero tie product renders together. Content is practical: collections, process, quote form, reviews.
watch_out: Generic dark Framer template feel; a chat widget overlays every frame and the heavy type gets loud.

name: Marine Layer

type.note: serif overlaid on photography in white

thesis: A warm lifestyle apparel store where location editorial photography leads and a nostalgic serif script logo and burgundy bar give heritage.
why_made: Every hero is a real on-location shot with white serif headline set directly over negative space; product grids use uniform tall model crops with tiny captions.
watch_out: Promotional furniture (burgundy bar, '15% off' tab, popups) crowds the frame; the serif over busy photos needs clear space.

name: Ne Geurra

type.text: Ivory 14px/1.2 grey; ABC Diatype ~10px for nav
type.note: whole site is one small size; hierarchy by case and grey only

thesis: A 20th-century furniture dealer presented like a museum catalogue: tiny serif index, single column of large photographs on cream paper.
why_made: Radical restraint (one 14px size, two greys, no buttons) with superb object photography and a three-column grid of index/image/category gives it gallery-grade authority. Information is genuinely useful: designer, year, dimensions.
watch_out: Without exceptional photography and exact baseline alignment this becomes sparse and unusable; tiny grey text can fail accessibility.

name: Virtual Tour Montenegro

type.note: serif display with sans body; section headings ~38px serif

thesis: A boutique 3D property-tour studio presented in warm sand tones with elegant serif headings and compact cards.
why_made: Disciplined palette of sand, taupe and near-black, a tight card radius system and consistent small caps labels make a local service feel premium.
watch_out: Beige card stacks can blur together; photography in the gallery is small and the many tiny cards risk looking like a template.

name: Omega Aqua Terra 150M

type.display: Omega custom serif-ish sans, 40px/48px, 400, uppercase, tracking 8%
type.note: red display title with italic script collection name above

thesis: A luxury watch collection page: pure white grid, centred logo and red title, with product cutouts doing all the work.
why_made: Extreme whitespace, matched-angle watch cutouts, centred nav and consistent tiny uppercase product captions feel luxurious and exact. Skeleton boxes load cleanly into images.
watch_out: Without perfect cutout photography the empty white grid looks like a broken page; many frames captured skeleton states.

name: Dragon Spirit Martial Arts

type.note: all-caps centred headings on blue

thesis: A local club site in one saturated cobalt blue with real class photos, clear schedule and map locations.
why_made: Disciplined single-blue and white palette, centred uppercase headings and practical location blocks with embedded maps make it clear and trustworthy.
watch_out: Photography is casual phone-quality and layouts are template-like; blue panels get heavy.

name: Mala Project

type.note: karaoke-style bilingual captions in yellow

thesis: A restaurant homepage that is a full-viewport blurred dreamscape of meadow, mountains and butterflies with a hand-painted brush logo and rotating bilingual captions.
why_made: Complete commitment to one surreal world, a tiny bilingual red nav and captioned thumbnails give a distinct food identity with live motion.
watch_out: No practical information visible above the fold and heavy blur effects; works for a brand like this, wrong as a default.

name: Heat Bureau

type.text: Inter Display 12.8px/24px 500; Suisse Intl Mono for labels
type.note: tiny mono-ish UI text vs enormous wordmark

thesis: A design studio site that behaves like a desktop OS: logo splash, then a collage of inverted fingerprint and thermal photography with a window opening to ever-smaller scenes.
why_made: Strong concept execution: heavy tonal contrast of infrared imagery, tiny uppercase UI, and a scroll that nests images inside images feel deliberate and expensive.
watch_out: Information is minimal and navigation cryptic; the OS-folder gimmick only works with this level of image quality.

name: First December Films

type.display: Tartuffo Trial serif, 120px/120px (80px in sections), 400, tracking -2.4px
type.text: PP Neue Montreal Medium 14-16px; DM Mono 11-12px labels
type.note: serif headings, mono slash-labels like '/ DATA'

thesis: An ad-film house that alternates a cinematic dark reel with an off-white editorial section, with a signature amber tab as the one accent.
why_made: The tight serif set at -2.4px tracking, black-and-white director portraits, and a single amber accent in fixed tags feel confident; real campaign footage does the persuading.
watch_out: Amber pill tabs and bottom-bar chips pile up on every frame; dense logo wall is generic.

name: Stripe Customers

type.note: Tiny size ladder 10-26px, one family

thesis: A customer-stories index where saturated story-card photography is the only colour on a near-white, hairline-quiet page.
why_made: Type sits in a tight scale with one family, cards share one 4/8px radius system, and brand-coloured imagery does all the decoration so the chrome stays invisible.
watch_out: Without the strong customer imagery and logo colour, the pale grey surfaces and small type read as an empty enterprise template.

name: Okey Studio

type.note: Two-word wordmark filling the viewport

thesis: A single-screen studio card that is just a giant two-line wordmark, a tagline and two pill buttons.
why_made: Extreme scale contrast between a ~200px sans wordmark and 10px caps text, on a warm paper tone, with a small mascot and toggle as only ornaments.
watch_out: One screen of oversized type with no content depth only works when the personality (mascot, copy voice) carries it.

name: Motionstrand

type.note: Hero headline ~40px centred

thesis: A dark navy page lit by a blurred lime-green glow with glass panels, aimed at pharma/healthcare digital work.
why_made: The green glow behind frosted panels gives depth with only one coral accent for CTAs; client photography is warm and human.
watch_out: The blurred-orb background looks cheap if the glass panels lose contrast or text sits on the bright lime.

name: Leica

type.note: Light weight on warm neutrals

thesis: A camera maker's site that lets product and photography sit on warm greys with light-weight type.
why_made: Warm off-white bands alternate with black hero imagery, imagery is credited and editorial, and type stays thin and small.
watch_out: Wide light type on busy white reads as templated corporate without the Leica photography.

name: Ripple Health

type.note: Hairline-thin display over cream

thesis: A dermatology care landing on cream with deep teal heroes, magenta CTA and watercolour botanical cards.
why_made: Warm cream, teal and one berry accent are held consistent; real smiling skin photography and soft-gradient sections avoid clinical coldness.
watch_out: The gradient and botanical card textures go twee if the type weight or contrast drops.

name: Almeida Theatre

type.note: Wordmark logo upside-offset

thesis: A theatre site where a full-bleed rehearsal photograph, heavy white caps and flat coral/yellow panels sit against black.
why_made: A strict black/white base with only two flat accent fields (coral, yellow) and sharp 2px radii gives it box-office authority; every show tile has paired actions.
watch_out: The loud flat colour blocks and heavy caps look amateur unless photography is as strong and spacing stays disciplined.

name: Hellgate

type.note: Standard dark SaaS scale

thesis: A dark payments infrastructure landing with a centred two-line headline, purple primary and diagrammatic product art.
why_made: Tight Inter display, a single purple accent and a node-diagram hero make a coherent technical story.
watch_out: Near-identical to countless dark SaaS pages if the diagrams are removed.

name: Elisa Breyer Archive

type.note: One size for all text

thesis: An artist's painting archive reduced to a dense edge-to-edge grid of colourful works with 14px text only.
why_made: The work is the entire interface: uniform 2-4px gutters, one typeface size, a tiny pill toggle for sort; colour comes entirely from the paintings.
watch_out: A dense image wall collapses without genuinely strong, consistently cropped artwork.

name: Avara
thesis: A black single-screen page of four outlined sticker mascots representing product families, with a centred logo and link row.
why_made: Sticker characters with coloured outlines are the nav; labels appear on hover and everything else is stripped away.
watch_out: Without distinctive characters and sound/hover delight, a black page with tiny links reads empty.

name: Levels

type.note: Tight negative tracking on display

thesis: A health product landing that mixes light and near-black bands with data-led UI cards in a restrained green-grey palette.
why_made: Tight Hoves display, consistent 10px-radius bordered cards, real product UI and pale green tints make the data feel credible and calm.
watch_out: Black stat cards and green tints turn clinical and generic if spacing and hairlines are loosened.

name: Checkout.com

type.note: Mono caps headlines

thesis: A payments landing that uses mono caps, giant blue numerals and a tilted fan of phone mockups on black.
why_made: Hard black with one electric blue and a mono display type gives strong identity; stats and product UI are shown big.
watch_out: All-caps mono shouting plus image fans becomes noisy if copy gets long.

name: MasterClass

type.note: Condensed caps headline

thesis: A streaming-style education landing on black with condensed caps, portrait photography and a red CTA.
why_made: Condensed caps, instructor portraits and a persistent sticky bottom bar with avatar stack give a premium media-brand feel.
watch_out: Heavy black with many red CTAs reads aggressive without portrait quality.

name: Studio Dado

type.note: Serif display against a neutral grotesk; all-caps serif for section statements.

thesis: A hospitality interior studio lets a full-bleed room render and a giant uppercase serif do all the work, with tiny grotesk metadata on a thin hairline grid.
why_made: Scale contrast is extreme (211px serif versus 13px labels) and everything snaps to a 4-column hairline grid. Photography is dark, warm and consistent, and the taupe preloader and footer tie it to the imagery.
watch_out: Without a tight column grid and real architectural renders, oversized serif caps and tiny labels look unfinished.

name: neon Switzerland

type.note: Hot pink headline on sky photo; pink is both type and fill.

thesis: A neobank uses one hot pink against a sky-and-cloud photo and soft grey bento cards, with pink full-bleed bands for card and app moments.
why_made: A single saturated accent used everywhere keeps the page consistent, and the photography of real people with the card is warm and human.
watch_out: Pink on pink and pastel cards become noisy without strict grey surface discipline.

name: Framify

type.note: Dense product-library marketing page.

thesis: A Framer asset marketplace page that shows the product itself as a collage of component thumbnails on grey with dotted frame guides.
why_made: Product screenshots are the decoration, with a consistent 12-16px radius system and quiet grey ground.
watch_out: Many small cards and badges quickly feel cluttered and template-like.

name: D Alexander CPA

type.note: Burgundy and charcoal, serif headline on photo.

thesis: A solo CPA practice built as a Framer template in burgundy, charcoal and grey with a warm personal portrait band.
why_made: Serif/sans pairing and a restrained burgundy accent give credibility; section colour bands make the scroll legible.
watch_out: Stock imagery and heavy grey bands can look dated without the real portrait.

name: KR8 bureau

type.display: NON Natural Regular, 62px, tracking 0.5px, centred caps
type.note: Glyph-and-symbol typography.

thesis: A Vienna branding bureau uses centred caps, inline glyph symbols and alternating white/black full-screen slides.
why_made: Total commitment to one typographic voice, with blurred gradient image tiles as the only colour.
watch_out: Only works with a strong concept; reads as chaos otherwise.

name: Kleiner Perkins

type.note: Almost no display type; the portfolio logos carry colour.

thesis: A venture firm shows nearly nothing: one phrase 'Make History' then a horizontal strip of portfolio tiles on pure black.
why_made: Confidence through absence; tiles in saturated colour pop out of black.
watch_out: Without strong portfolio brand tiles the black page just looks empty.

name: Colorado Marketplace & Bakery

type.display: EB Garamond 95px/400, italic gold accent word
type.note: Navy, oat, brass.

thesis: A local bakery in navy, oat and brass with warm food photography and an italic serif headline.
why_made: Tight three-colour palette and a good logo seal give it a considered boutique feel.
watch_out: Gold button on navy and tiny caps nav can feel dated.

name: PDA Architecture

type.note: Warm stone ground, white overlay type.

thesis: An architecture studio on warm stone with full-bleed photography and an asymmetric staggered image layout.
why_made: Subtle stone background, one black pill CTA and photographic scale; staggered photo crops scroll in precisely.
watch_out: Needs great photography; the pale preloader is long.

name: YOLO.EXE

type.note: Arcade neon.

thesis: A retro arcade-style title screen with neon yellow extruded type, magenta start button and synthwave grid.
why_made: Theming is committed: type, 3D press button and scanline grid all match.
watch_out: Neon arcade tropes are cliche unless the product is a game.

name: Postevand

type.note: Mostly Helvetica style, small caps labels.

thesis: A water-in-carton brand using huge Helvetica wordmark, 3D carton scroll sequence and fine hairline layout.
why_made: Neo-grotesk at scale on white with a rotating product object is simple and consistent; fine rules give shop feel.
watch_out: The newsletter modal blocks content immediately and is intrusive.

name: La Table de Joakim

type.note: Mono caps for body, serif caps for headings, handwritten logo.

thesis: A private-chef catering site where full-screen colour fields, one dish photo per screen and mono caps copy make a quiet menu-card rhythm.
why_made: Each screen is one idea with generous empty space; the tonal fields (mocha, powder blue, cream) are pulled from the food; serif/mono pairing and a handwritten signature feel owned.
watch_out: Mono caps body is hard to read long-form and the pale text on blue is low contrast.

name: Aman

type.text: Lyon Text Web ~14px/1.6 body; WhitneySSm 10-13px caps labels
type.note: serif headings with small tracked sans eyebrows

thesis: A luxury resort portfolio presented as a quiet editorial magazine: warm paper, huge photography, almost no UI.
why_made: Every pixel of colour comes from the photography because the chrome is a single warm neutral with one charcoal button. Spacing is generous and strictly repeated, and type is small and tracked rather than loud.
watch_out: With stock photos or a bright accent colour the restraint reads as empty rather than expensive.

name: Dishoom

type.text: Cheltenham BT ~18px serif body justified; Gill Sans Nova 12-15px caps nav
type.note: Bombay cafe print ephemera: double-rule frames, italic subheads

thesis: A restaurant group site styled as vintage Bombay printed matter, with film footage and food photography doing the selling.
why_made: The system is committed: one cream paper colour, double-rule frames, tracked caps and justified serif, so every section feels like the same menu card. Photography is warm, candid and generous.
watch_out: Double borders and italic serif turn kitsch without real photography and a coherent paper palette.

name: KTA+ Store

type.note: navy-blue promo bar over photographic hero

thesis: A Christian homeschool resource store: photographic hero, then a dark product carousel and clean white lead-capture sections.
why_made: Consistent 20/16px radii, a clear dark/white alternation and well-structured product cards give it a credible store feel.
watch_out: Dark carousel with tiny text and many tags gets dense and loses hierarchy without strict sizing.

name: Snog

type.note: condensed red wordmark on white

thesis: A production company portfolio as a scattered poster wall with an enormous red condensed title that swaps per project.
why_made: One brand red on pure white and unfiltered key art give extreme clarity; the loading wordmark is memorable.
watch_out: Scattered collage with random sizes looks chaotic without strong key art and the single type voice.

name: Birdie

type.note: tight sans with mono eyebrows

thesis: Screen recording for support: white product page with iridescent blue gradient showcases and a dark closing CTA.
why_made: Tight display tracking, product UI as the hero and a single saturated blue panel give clear rhythm.
watch_out: The gradient glass screens need real product UI; with placeholders it looks like stock.

name: HealthyHer

type.note: serif display with geometric sans

thesis: A PCOS wellness brand for Filipina women: warm cream, teal and butter yellow with candid photography and product shots.
why_made: A three-colour palette is applied consistently, photography is human and diverse, and content sections cover real product and education needs.
watch_out: The yellow bar plus teal blocks gets loud if photos are not warm and candid.

name: Pier88 Coast

type.display: Golden Hopes script + Tan Mon Cheri, 75px
type.note: curved script overlays

thesis: A coastal beach club: scroll-driven plate that becomes breakfast, dinner and beyond, with full-bleed sea photography and script type.
why_made: Concept is carried by a single physical object, a gold-rimmed plate, and the photography is aspirational and fresh.
watch_out: Script fonts, curved text and playful illustrations become kitsch without a strong object concept.

name: Zahnarzt Wernitz

type.note: navy huge headline with blobs

thesis: A friendly dental practice: pale blue blob backgrounds, giant navy headings and a yellow accent for actions and smiley.
why_made: Practical info is clearly structured with yellow marks for key actions and warm real-person photos, which is rare for clinics.
watch_out: Blob shapes and floating cards go childish without disciplined navy type.

name: Velora

type.note: oversized cream wordmark

thesis: A handmade lighting brand: a giant cream wordmark over workshop footage, then a private-list modal with an editorial lamp photo.
why_made: The oversized cropped wordmark over craft footage is confident and ownable; the modal splits image and form cleanly.
watch_out: The wordmark cropped at the bottom breaks when the footage is flat or light.

name: Cash App

type.note: signature neon green

thesis: A fintech page alternating neon green, white and black full-viewport scenes, each built around one phone or card object.
why_made: Each scene has one object, one headline and one small outlined CTA; the repeated structure gives control.
watch_out: Neon green only works with black and white discipline and polished product visuals.

name: Golden Assisted Transportation

type.note: navy and gold trust palette

thesis: A local wheelchair transport service built around fast booking: hero with embedded stepper, persistent call bar, plain-language service info.
why_made: Information architecture is excellent for real customers with a stepper form, pricing explanation, FAQ and persistent call/book bar.
watch_out: Gold CTA on navy bar can feel heavy if repeated beside other buttons.

name: Apétiti

type.display: Inter 700, ~60-120px, lh 1.0, tracking normal, with Playfair Display italic accent words
type.note: Italic serif swapped into one word per headline (spécial, aventure, cool)

thesis: Kids' smoothie pouch brand told through cream paper, navy ink and cut-out fruit characters, with one italic serif word per headline for warmth.
why_made: Consistent cream ground with navy CTAs and a single mascot illustration style carries the whole page; real photography of children supplies a counterweight to the cartoons.
watch_out: The playful fruit mascots and green leaf bullets turn childish fast if the cream/navy discipline and generous whitespace are dropped.

name: Sam Peitz

type.note: Tiny monospaced text laid over a video

thesis: A looping video of venetian blinds is the entire page, with lowercase mono sentences and thumbnail slivers hidden in the slats.
why_made: Concept is singular and committed: the blinds are the layout, with a time-of-day control that changes the light.
watch_out: Text reads as nearly illegible over the slats, so this only works as a one-idea portfolio.

name: Utopia Orchestra

type.display: Utopia (custom wordmark) 112px/400 lh 1.05; Iowan Old Style serif body
type.note: Names scattered in uppercase sans around the mark

thesis: A pan-and-zoom constellation of names, concerts and photos orbiting a centered wordmark on near-black.
why_made: Near-black #161616 with a single typographic mark and tiny scattered labels gives an orchestral hush; the ticker bar anchors the scene.
watch_out: The spatial canvas hides navigation; without the ticker and clear entry cue it is unusable.

name: Typohypergraphic Object

type.note: Centered, hyphenated title

thesis: A long, white, centered-column book page that treats the publication as an object, with full images and tiny captions.
why_made: Total restraint: one serif, one column, huge margins, plates shown at their true aspect and captioned like a catalogue.
watch_out: Works only because the book imagery is extraordinary; with weak imagery it reads as an unstyled page.

name: FORUM Cases

type.note: Shippori Mincho for the 'Join the Forum' serif line

thesis: Rifle-case maker uses a classical-statue brand world on matte black with wide-tracked condensed caps and product shots lit like sculpture.
why_made: Disciplined palette of blacks and one pale grey, with a mono-line logo and statue imagery that give the brand a clear story.
watch_out: Heavy letterspacing and statue imagery can feel costume-like without strong product photography.

name: Tim Rodenbroeker

type.note: Orange top bar with white 13px links

thesis: Swiss-leaning personal site: orange bar, greyscale portrait and plain-text index lists beside tile previews of projects.
why_made: Strict single typeface with black-on-white lists, hairline rules, and one saturated orange bar give it confident clarity.
watch_out: Default-browser blue links and lists look unfinished without the precise grid and strong imagery.

name: Boudin Bakery

type.display: Cheltenham serif headings; DIN 700 32px, tracking 3px, uppercase
type.note: Red #cc0000 buttons

thesis: Heritage bakery uses a seasonal hero carousel, warm brown and cream bands, and red uppercase buttons.
why_made: The photography is excellent and consistent, with a clear red-and-brown brand system and practical order paths.
watch_out: Faint line-art watermarks and stacked red buttons look dated if the photography is not this strong.

name: Roy Jad

type.note: Tiny mono captions against huge white space

thesis: A near-white spatial canvas of project panes that pans sideways, labelled in tiny monospaced caps with an INFO/WORK toggle.
why_made: Almost no ink: pixel-font display, hairline-bordered 10-12px-radius panes with soft 3D tilt, a single orange accent in the pixel logo, and a segmented toggle as the sole nav.
watch_out: Without real project screenshots of this quality the emptiness reads as unfinished.

name: Sakara

type.note: Uppercase 13px/600 buttons

thesis: Wellness food brand pairs a light serif display with deep green studio product photography and quiet uppercase UI.
why_made: A two-tone hero (black copy panel, saturated green photo panel) gives a luxurious product moment; mobile keeps the same hierarchy.
watch_out: A welcome-offer modal that appears within 2s covers the hero and undermines the polish.

name: Roundhouse

type.display: Ozik 107px/500 lh 0.8; Work Sans 700 uppercase for headings
type.note: Acid lime accent #d4ff00 for chips
