thesis: A black venue site with a red rotating roundel logo, lime pills, red cards and heavy condensed capitals for programmes.
why_made: Strong ownable palette: black ground, signal red and lime with a circular text logo that doubles as a stamp.
watch_out: Large empty black video/image tiles dominate here; without loaded imagery it looks broken, and mobile overflows horizontally.

name: 1 Hotels

type.note: Hand-drawn script accent 'The Field Guide'

thesis: Luxury eco hotel brand: warm stone page, forest-green controls, tracked caps type and nature photography with real numbers over it.
why_made: Warm #f2efe8 ground, one forest green, wide-tracked caps Brown, and big photographic panes with generous gutters feel expensive and calm; booking CTA is always present.
watch_out: Tracked caps over photographs require dark scrims and large type; otherwise legibility collapses.

name: edX

type.note: Deep teal #062429 bands

thesis: Course marketplace in deep teal and warm cream with an orange CTA, tilted italic headlines and a dense catalog.
why_made: Strong colour banding and a consistent card/pill radius system keep a huge catalogue scannable.
watch_out: Heavy italic Inter 900 can look shouty; the mascot chat widget clutters every frame.

name: Decathlon Yestalgia

type.note: Condensed black caps and stickers

thesis: A retro 80s-90s sportswear nostalgia site with pink grounds, memphis shapes, giant condensed caps and a lime sticker nav.
why_made: Committed palette (pink, orange, lime, black) and sticker-like shapes with hard black outlines hold together across every section.
watch_out: Memphis shapes and giant caps are brand-specific and age quickly if dropped into a calm brand.

name: Oliver Dupuy

type.display: Korpus (spaced serif caps), 14px, 400, +2.45px tracking, only size on site
type.note: One size, one weight; hierarchy comes only from position and case

thesis: Architecture portfolio as a white spread: a tall photograph slides across a blank page with project name left and place/year right.
why_made: Total restraint: one 14px letterspaced serif, a white field and large editorial interior photography with warm, consistent grading. Nothing competes with the images.
watch_out: Without exceptional, uniformly graded photography and exact centring, this much emptiness reads as an unfinished page.

name: Figure

type.display: PP Neue Machina Plain, 52px/57.7 (1.1), 400, uppercase, tracking normal
type.note: Uppercase wide-set display over full-bleed film, grotesk body

thesis: Full-bleed cinematic robot film chapters with a tiny bottom-left caption and one outlined button, ending in a numbered index footer.
why_made: Real film and photography do all the work; type is small, uppercase and anchored to the same bottom-left grid on every chapter, with a graduated scrim that keeps contrast without a visible overlay.
watch_out: Needs genuinely cinematic footage; with stock imagery the sparse type reads as empty.

name: Shopify Supply | Performance Pack

type.note: Italic sport display + mono HUD labels

thesis: Merch drop as a dark HUD: slanted diagonal stripes, 3D product pieces and lifestyle photos sliding past with mono callouts and crosshairs.
why_made: A strict system (dark #0f0f0f, one Shopify green, crosshair/bracket corner marks, mono labels) carries a very busy product/lookbook sequence; WebGL product rotations are consistent.
watch_out: The motion and diagonal ground need constant art direction; as a template it becomes cluttered.

name: Orion Icon Library

type.note: Dark opener flips to white sections

thesis: Icon library product page that previews real icon grids in an app-window frame over a purple glow, then shows icon details on white.
why_made: The product itself (real icons, line/solid/colour/flat tabs) is the content; icons drawn at consistent stroke and shown at scale.
watch_out: Mixed dark/white sections and pastel gradient feel dated without tighter spacing.

name: Waymo

type.note: Light-weight big numerals, cobalt blue + navy

thesis: Autonomous ride-hailing brand page alternating navy night footage, white vehicle shots and cobalt-blue testimonial and sign-up bands.
why_made: Strong colour blocks (#006fee, #070f1e), big light numerals and a real route-map illustration keep it brand-owned; photography is cinematic.
watch_out: Pages of small legal and footer text with blue blocks can feel heavy.

name: Sonar

type.note: Pure neutral grotesque, mint logo as only colour

thesis: Festival site as a restrained white information page: lead photo, inline lineup text, ticket-tier table and sponsor strip.
why_made: Real festival information is organized plainly: artist names inline with pipe separators, ticket cards with radios and prices, one black button style.
watch_out: Beautiful only because of plain type; spacing errors would show.

name: sen knife by Takahashikusu

type.note: Large light type slicing across product

thesis: Knife brand as a gray tactile world: debossed pattern intro, giant product names that wipe through vertical blade-slats as each knife and colour swaps.
why_made: Product photography and typography are choreographed together: names are cut by slat masks while knives rotate, with colour swapping the entire background.
watch_out: Motion carries everything; static it is just grey.

name: 2819 Church

type.note: Black heavy grotesque with red overprint words

thesis: Church homepage in poster language: stacked heavy black type, red accent words, tiny bracketed links and cut-out black-and-white photos on a paper-white field.
why_made: Two colours plus monochrome crowd photography, applied consistently across headline, bracketed link and vertical rail text.
watch_out: Tight tracking and overlapping photos get illegible without careful per-breakpoint control.

name: Solidcore

type.note: Condensed all-caps headings, electric blue

thesis: Fitness studio homepage: black photographic hero overlapped by a blue booking card and a white 'new?' card, then promo and app sections.
why_made: Clear action hierarchy: blue filled card with primary CTA vs outlined card; condensed uppercase headings and a single blue.
watch_out: Template-ish sections (checklist, calendar CTA) are generic.

name: ECAL

type.note: Custom grotesque, swiss black-white with graphic posters

thesis: Art-school homepage as Swiss typographic grid: black hero block for Open Day, dense event/article columns with colourful poster thumbnails, large lowercase wordmark.
why_made: Custom typeface used at very large display size in pure black/white; dense multi-column news lists are tightly set and aligned on a visible column grid.
watch_out: Dense small type with cookie banner and empty carousels risks looking unfinished.

name: Lucid

type.note: Serif section heads, sans UI, champagne gold CTA

thesis: Premium EV homepage on near-black with cinematic photography, serif headings, and rounded image tiles.
why_made: Disciplined dark ladder (#0f0f0f/#21201c), a single warm champagne accent, serif display against sans labels, consistent 4-8px radii on image tiles.
watch_out: Dark premium look collapses without high-grade photography.

name: Velvele

type.note: navy #262b52 and coral #da5942 as section blocks, electric blue pill CTA

thesis: A Milan branding studio sets one enormous black wordmark on white and lets saturated colour live only in the work thumbnails and coloured service blocks.
why_made: Restraint on the chrome (white, black, one blue) makes the loud client artwork read as the colour. Radii are consistent (28/40px) and the horizontal drift of cards is smooth.
watch_out: Without strong client artwork the white canvas and giant logotype look empty and the tiny body text unreadable.

name: Linear Method

type.display: Tiempos Headline, 128px/128 desktop (~48px mobile), 400, tracking normal
type.note: serif display against Inter UI is the only contrast move

thesis: A near-black editorial page where one serif headline and faint geometric line art carry the whole first screen.
why_made: Extreme restraint: one serif, one sans, hairline art at ~10% opacity, a numbered contents list. Everything is quiet so the headline feels expensive.
watch_out: Dark empty space with a thin serif looks unfinished unless the type size, leading and hairline art are exact.

name: Meech213

type.note: menu items fade in grey then darken when active

thesis: A creative-director portfolio where the navigation is a floating orbit of tilted photo cards that scroll past a ghosted category list.
why_made: Off-white warm canvas with zero chrome; photos carry all colour. Cards tilt at varied angles with no borders, creating depth like a mood board.
watch_out: Needs strong editorial photography and a WebGL scrubber; with weak images or slow load the page is simply blank (first 6s are empty).

name: Yves Tumor - Safe In The Hands of Love

type.note: hand-signed logos used as footer headings

thesis: A record-release microsite where grey-green loader gives way to white, ink-smudge figures and a black strip of handwritten artist logos.
why_made: Almost no UI: three lines of text, brush-ink figures and signatures give an authentic zine feel without type tricks.
watch_out: Little content and low contrast loader; looks unfinished without the artwork's strong handmade imagery.

name: Tobacco Theater

type.display: Bebas Neue Pro 120px/96, 700, tracking -2.4px; Baskerville italic for subheads
type.note: condensed yellow caps + italic serif pairing

thesis: An Amsterdam theatre whose pages change background colour (video navy, pink, teal, green) while a condensed yellow wordmark and italic serif tie it together.
why_made: Strong brand pairing (Bebas + Baskerville italic) with consistent yellow accent and theatre photography; colour changes feel staged like acts.
watch_out: Pink, yellow, teal and green together turn garish without the dark photography and consistent type pair.

name: Death to Robots

type.display: Inter Display 75px/75, 500, tracking -2.25px; Libre Caslon italic accent words
type.note: italic serif only on one word per headline

thesis: A hospitality-brand video studio mixing dark near-black screens, a pink manifesto panel and full-bleed resort footage.
why_made: Single italic serif word in a sans headline and a pink panel break give editorial rhythm; footage fills the frames.
watch_out: The italic word swap and pink panel look gimmicky if used on every heading.

name: Vrdnt Work

type.note: green highlighter-stroke under key phrase in headings

thesis: A coworking space in Missouri using forest green, a lime accent and leaf-geometry pattern to feel local and fresh rather than corporate.
why_made: A tight green-plus-white system, white cards over green photography, and real info (address, price, tour booking) in every section.
watch_out: Lime on dark green and small grey text lose contrast; leaf pattern is risky outside this brand.

name: Enigma

type.note: serif italic caps, warm brown smoke

thesis: A styling-subscription brand framed as a mystery: WebGL smoke cloud hero with italic serif 'Decode your style' on near-black brown.
why_made: Single warm palette from black to caramel, light italic serif and slow smoke create tone; the Mystery Box section is minimal.
watch_out: Slow WebGL and low-contrast tiny copy on black hurt legibility and commerce clarity.

name: Joby

type.display: jobyDisplay, 143px/1.0 desktop hero, 550 weight, -3% tracking (hero headline ~64px)
type.note: Warm cream (#f4efdf) type instead of pure white keeps photography cinematic.

thesis: A cinematic scroll film where full-bleed warm photography sits inside a single saturated blue frame, so the brand colour acts as the stage rather than decoration.
why_made: One accent blue, one cream, one near-black; every photograph is graded to the same amber-dusk palette and the huge rounded-corner frame ties hero, blue statement and cream sections together. Type is sparse and tightly tracked.
watch_out: Without equally graded, art-directed photography and one disciplined blue, the oversized radius and giant type just look like a heavy template.

name: White Cube

type.note: Only black, white and a grey; the art supplies all colour.

thesis: A white-box gallery site: monochrome type, huge installation photographs and generous gutters so the artworks are the only colour.
why_made: Strict hierarchy of tiny uppercase labels, italic artwork titles and a single narrow text column; images use true gallery photographs with no overlays, and layout alternates asymmetric text/image pairs with consistent 68px outer margins.
watch_out: Without excellent installation photography and exacting alignment, this restraint reads as an empty template.

name: Leo Cussen Centre for Law

type.display: Moulin Light, 58px/1.0, weight 300, uppercase in hero, mixed case in sections
type.note: Light high-contrast serif paired with a friendly grotesk.

thesis: A professional-education site that turns a single yellow into a gradient wash over photography, paired with a light serif so it feels warm but credible.
why_made: One yellow, one warm off-white and black; the hero fades yellow into the video, nav is a floating rounded bar, and stats appear as oversized serif numerals. Rhythm alternates cream and yellow bands consistently.
watch_out: Saturated yellow beside black type becomes loud and cheap if the neutral warm off-white and light serif are missing.

name: The Candy Vault

type.note: Quirky variable grotesque with plum tone suits sweets.

thesis: A sweet shop built from blurred candy-jar photography, plum surfaces and amoeba-shaped category blobs.
why_made: A fixed palette of plum, candy pink and lime keeps the playfulness controlled; products sit in clean hairline grids and the hero uses blur-to-sharp focus pull on a real jar shelf.
watch_out: The blobs and bright pastels need the strict plum ground and hairline grids, otherwise it slips into children's clip-art.

name: Lonvital

type.display: Outfit, 56px/1.0, weight 600; wordmark in light 300 caps
type.note: Spanish medical copy; wordmark is thin geometric caps.

thesis: A telehealth clinic framed in deep navy with UI fragments of its app, switching to light cards where trust and evidence are needed.
why_made: Consistent navy ladder, one blue CTA, pill shapes and detailed product fragments make a clinical service feel like software; light/dark section alternation separates claims from proof.
watch_out: Gradient navy and glow nodes can feel generic AI-health if the real content blocks are replaced by stock icons.

name: charity: water

type.note: Warm serif headlines with humanist sans.

thesis: A donation-first nonprofit page: one joyful portrait, an embedded giving widget, then proof via live data map.
why_made: Strong single-colour yellow action across the page, honest documentary photography, cream surfaces and a dark map band that gives hierarchy and trust.
watch_out: Yellow buttons and cream panels turn charity-template unless photography is real and the serif is set well.

name: Lil Italy

type.note: Chunky display headings give trattoria sign feeling.

thesis: A neighbourhood bistro site dressed in tomato red, cream and gingham, with food photography in rounded sheets.
why_made: Limited palette of oxblood red on blush cream, consistent 16px radii, line-art illustration as a break, and clear booking pills in header make it purposeful.
watch_out: Heavy display caps and gingham clichés turn kitsch unless the photography is sharp and radii stay consistent.

name: London Short Film Festival

type.note: Mono microcopy against giant grotesk.

thesis: A festival poster: acid-lime field with a giant tracked headline beside a stack of dark cinema photographs.
why_made: Two-colour poster system with mono microcopy, hard vertical divider and a soft grey gradient seam; frames of the load sequence show photo tiles shuffling in.
watch_out: Acid lime with huge type becomes harsh without the near-black photographic counterweight.

name: Hinge Health

type.note: Forest-green headlines on white.

thesis: A friendly healthcare brand in forest and mint green with large human photography and motion-capture overlays.
why_made: A one-hue green system (forest, mint, cream) keeps the clinical story calm; hero video, rounded media cards and green pill CTAs are consistent.
watch_out: The green pill CTAs and mint cards become a generic health template if the photography is stock.

name: AlphaTauri

type.note: Tight caps over imagery.

thesis: A fashion store that lets full-bleed winter lookbooks lead and keeps commerce UI to small white pills and caps labels.
why_made: Edge-to-edge photography with consistent cool, snowy grading, tiny uppercase labels and a black footer; panels with blurred glass CTAs sit over the images.
watch_out: Overlaid glass pills and caps copy get illegible without very controlled image tonality.

name: montarville

type.text: General Sans 13-18px, Sono Proportional for micro labels
type.note: single red #d0112b used only on CTAs and tiny section markers

thesis: A construction-management firm presented as near-black architecture editorial with interior photography as the only colour besides one red.
why_made: Disciplined palette (charcoal, warm grey, one red), huge wordmark footer and photography that carries the colour; copy-light panels float over full-bleed project images.
watch_out: The cookie banner and floating panels crowd the frames; without strong photography the black plus red would read as generic dark theme.

name: Massugu Hungary

type.note: wide-tracked caps wordmark treatment

thesis: Premium hairdressing-scissor brand in white and grey with a single red, using a monochrome gradient hero and wide-tracked caps.
why_made: Letterspaced Raleway caps and product photography on white feel precise like the tools sold; red is limited to logo and buttons.
watch_out: Wide tracking at 20px only works with very short words; on body copy or long headings it collapses legibility.

name: Onyx Coffee Lab

type.display: Bajern blackletter ~68px/68px 400 lowercase; Kapra script for signatures
type.note: blackletter and handwritten script on oxblood and cream

thesis: A specialty coffee roaster with a tattoo-flash identity: blackletter headlines, script signature, oxblood hero and cream editorial sections.
why_made: Very consistent system: blackletter display + Montserrat body + one black button, alternating cream and dark photo blocks, real photography.
watch_out: Blackletter display is brand-specific; copied onto a neutral business it looks like a costume.

name: ROEH Law & Tax

type.note: coral #e84a5f, black, cream

thesis: A Mexican law and tax firm using black and coral blocks with a serif headline, framed by a branded coral loading screen.
why_made: Confident use of full-bleed coral and black planes with a bespoke griffin mark, serif headings giving gravity to a legal practice.
watch_out: Mixing Exo 2 sans with Merriweather serif and a floating white nav pill feels unsettled; cookie bar covers content.

name: Fidèle

type.display: Basel Grotesk Book 62px/57px 400, -1px tracking, mixed with a serif accent word
type.note: single electric blue on warm cream, product covers carry all other colour

thesis: A risograph publisher's shop where one electric blue ink on cream becomes the whole interface, so book covers supply the colour.
why_made: One ink colour for type, rules and UI and zero decoration; tight type, honest product grid and enormous footer wordmark feel like a printed object.
watch_out: One-colour restraint needs genuinely colourful products; on a bland catalogue it looks unfinished.

name: Nritya Mohana

type.note: gold #e6cca3 on warm black

thesis: A kathak dance academy introduced through a cinematic dark opening with the teacher's name huge behind a figure, then switching to bright photo sections.
why_made: Photography is the whole design: dancers cut out and layered between oversize serif letters, with gold accents and a sound-gate load screen.
watch_out: Heavy WebGL and sound-gated loading would frustrate users on weak devices; the white mid-page band breaks the mood.

name: EverShee

type.note: aubergine #470f2c with blush #f8f3f6

thesis: A women's wellness community framed in deep aubergine and blush with warm portraits, soft pill UI and serif headlines.
why_made: Cohesive palette, a floating white pill nav and warm natural photography that actually looks like the audience; two-tone sections alternate rhythm.
watch_out: Stock-looking AI-ish imagery and generic benefit icons read template-like; the plum background drags on repeated slides.

name: Arya Bhangy Builders

type.note: warm cream with brown and charcoal

thesis: A Kochi real-estate builder tells its history as a time-line beside rotating building photography.
why_made: Calm warm palette, a lovely vertical year selector and consistent bordered corner-bracket photography suggest a considered, mature local business.
watch_out: Cream-on-cream panels with tiny grey text lose contrast; the empty white load takes several seconds.

name: Bristol Yoga Festival

type.note: charcoal with antique gold #c6a96c

thesis: A yoga festival rendered as an art-deco ornamental programme: gold dividers and rounded photos on dark charcoal damask.
why_made: One accent gold, repeated ornament dividers with diamond centres and consistent 15px-radius photos give strong coherence for an event.
watch_out: Small tracked grey body text on dark charcoal is low contrast; gold ornament overused becomes kitsch.

name: Central

type.display: American Grotesk Condensed Bold 152px/144px 700, -1.5px tracking, uppercase
type.note: cream display on near-black with one pure red

thesis: A payroll product dressed in newspaper-condensed type and a single red, sold through founders' quotes and UI fragments.
why_made: Dense condensed caps headlines with Söhne give a strong voice; UI fragments show real product and quotes add proof.
watch_out: Pure red #e50000 on black buttons and tiny corner radius feel harsh; the near-flat dark pages rely on type alone.

name: Aarretuote

type.note: black with warm cream serif

thesis: A Finnish sauna maker presents one product in cinematic, forest-lit photography on black with serif captions.
why_made: Rich, moody product photography with rounded 20px frames and restrained serif captions, price set apart as a single large number.
watch_out: Pure black pages with tiny captions leave long empty areas; specs lists are cramped.

name: Vercel Pricing

type.note: Geist Mono appears only for the '/mo.' unit and chart labels. Medium weights everywhere; nothing is bold.

thesis: A pricing page treated as a reference document: three plans in a seamless grid, then a 15,000px feature matrix that stays readable because it has no decoration at all.
why_made: One neutral ladder, one border colour and one row rhythm hold across a very long table. Every hierarchy decision is made with weight, size and a single white cell rather than colour.
watch_out: Without real depth of content and exact row rhythm, a colourless page just looks like an unstyled table.

name: Swirple

type.note: Rocks Regular wordmark at very large sizes; italic serif and Satoshi used as contrast voices.

thesis: A TikTok-alternative launch page built like a sticker sheet: ultra-heavy condensed caps, glossy tilted labels and pinned phones in lilac and black.
why_made: The heavy type sizing is confident and the motion is genuinely built, with pinned phones, stacked cards and tilting sheets. The one hue family keeps the chaos of voices together.
watch_out: Glossy stickers, Memphis shapes and four typefaces collapse into noise without the single lilac hue and very large type.

name: Cloudflare Workers

type.note: Apercu Mono Pro at 13-14px labels code and diagrams; very tight leading on body is a signature.

thesis: A serverless product page drawn as an engineer's blueprint: visible grid rails, corner handles and orange wire diagrams replace screenshots.
why_made: One schematic language runs through frames, tags, code boxes and illustrations, so every section belongs to the same drawing. Orange is rationed to CTAs, diagrams and one big closing panel.
watch_out: Rails and dot fields without a real column system become decorative grid wallpaper.

name: Loops

type.note: Serif only for headings and numerals; all product UI in Inter; mono for code and tokens. Display sizes stay modest.

thesis: An email SaaS page in warm paper tones, where four retro stripes run around the whole page like a record sleeve and real product demos do the selling.
why_made: A single ownable device, the stripe rail, starts at the hero, bends around the product and wraps the footer. Everything inside stays quiet: one card shell, one heading pattern, one 'Learn' row, repeated exactly.
watch_out: The stripes only work if they travel with real curves; pasted as a static border they turn into a 70s pastiche.

name: Mercury Pricing

type.note: Unusual in-between weights, 420 and 480, keep it soft.

thesis: A bank's pricing page that favours calm: one contained plan sheet, collapsed comparison, lavender FAQ and legal typeset with care.
why_made: Cool tints replace greys so the page feels banked and quiet, and even disclosures get layout. It is a careful, conventional page rather than a distinctive one.
watch_out: Periwinkle on lavender quickly reads as generic fintech if the type weights are not this soft.

name: Mixpanel

type.note: ABC Arizona light italic for quotes; Apercu for UI inside demos.

thesis: An analytics brand drawn on a visible ruled frame, with colour pouring in through bar-like gradient slats and full dark floods.
why_made: The ruled grid and halftone strips give the loud gradients a strict structure, and each product gets its own hue. The AI chat widget permanently covering the lower right stops it reaching top tier.
watch_out: Saturated gradients with no ruled frame around them fall straight into generic AI SaaS.

name: BILD

type.note: Geist Mono at 11-12px for tabs and eyebrows.

thesis: A construction voice-note app sold through a soft sky, a real interactive phone demo and a friendly 3D site-foreman robot.
why_made: The hero is a real step-through demo rather than a mock image, and the 3D mascot and helmet render give it its own identity. The capture is short, and the page beyond the demo stays simple.
watch_out: A 3D mascot needs real render quality; a stock-looking robot would make it a toy.

name: Bitnomi

type.note: Sizes jump 48 to 72; 168px Poppins Black for one bento word.

thesis: A Sri Lankan Bitcoin wallet in black and antique gold, with red copper light at the corners and large phone mockups carrying each step.
why_made: Gold is held to rims, titles and one button, and phone screens are real, so it feels considered. Stacked centred sections and stock-like renders keep it short of top tier.
watch_out: Black plus gold plus 3D coins turns into a crypto cliché unless gold stays thin and scarce.

name: Outschool

type.note: Ultra-wide display against a friendly humanist text cut.

thesis: A children's class marketplace with real brand conviction: ultra-wide type, periwinkle and yellow floods, and riso-textured blobs.
why_made: The wide display face and printed textures make it unmistakable, and marketplace parts like search and class cards stay functional. The dense consumer funnel and a sticky promo popup keep it from being restrained.
watch_out: Blobs and flood colours without a strong display font and real child photography become a generic edtech kit.

name: Taschen

type.note: Wordmark in Founders Grotesk Condensed

thesis: A white gallery wall where the book covers supply all the colour, with commerce rows reduced to title, price and a 30px button.
why_made: Product imagery is the only chroma, so the grid reads as a bookshelf; every card repeats one rigid caption stack, which makes dense catalogues scan cleanly.
watch_out: Without rich cover art and the strict caption rhythm, the tiny 12px grey text on pure white looks like a bare template.

name: Dailee by Daily Fresh Fruits

type.note: Brush-script logo in green/orange

thesis: A cream page with fat rounded colour tiles per flavour, each carrying a tilted bottle, in a playful Framer build.
why_made: One strict radius language (big pills, 30-80px tiles) and saturated flat fills tied to each SKU keep the playfulness organised.
watch_out: Without the tight product photography and consistent tile radii, the loud colours slide into children's-brand clip art.

name: Developments

type.display: Folio BT Light, up to 317px, lh 0.8, -19px (-6%)
type.note: Italic Folio Light for kicker lines

thesis: A scroll of giant possessive headlines, each with a tiny hand-drawn diagram and a three-line caption, like an index of interviews.
why_made: Extreme scale contrast between 150px+ headlines and 12px captions with a single hairline structure feels deliberate and editorial.
watch_out: The giant tight-tracked type clips and collides if line-height or viewport is not controlled; it is wrong for informational pages.

name: Royal Ontario Museum

type.note: Giant fixed ROM wordmark doubles as logo and graphic

thesis: A museum site where the building and objects fill the screen, a huge condensed ROM mark anchors every section and practical visit info stays a tidy 3-up.
why_made: Full-bleed documentary photography alternates with disciplined white sections; condensed display type is used at a few fixed scales and everything else is quiet 16px grotesk.
watch_out: The condensed wordmark overlapping photos only works with darkened, calm image areas; on busy photos it turns illegible.

name: Josh Comeau

type.note: Cartograph mono for code

thesis: A personal blog framed by an illustrated sky and a pixel rainbow that builds in on load, with a plain two-column reading list below.
why_made: Illustration and motion are concentrated in one hero moment while the reading column is calm; detailed 79-keyframe micro interactions show craft.
watch_out: Without the custom illustration the page is a standard blog list; imitating the cuteness without craft looks juvenile.

name: Hydrow

type.note: Mixed serif and sans lines in one headline

thesis: A looping montage of rowers, water and light under a centred mixed-type headline and one white pill.
why_made: Colour-graded footage cycling orange and deep blue gives a cinematic identity; the headline mixing light serif with heavy sans is the single brand move.
watch_out: Text over moving footage needs scrim and tested contrast; the pill nav and 76px CTA can feel heavy.

name: Motto

type.display: Display sans, 154px/500, lh 1.0, uppercase, justified to measure
type.note: Registered mark after names; (SCROLL) in parentheses

thesis: A pale grey grid of hairlines holding enormous justified uppercase statements, tiny rectangular photos and a few crafted details.
why_made: Everything sits on one 1px rule grid and one grotesk, so scale does the work; the justified headline spread across two ruled rows is a memorable signature.
watch_out: Needs real photography, strict rules and generous space; with weak images it is just big text on grey.

name: Nike Better World

type.display: FuturaNike 81px/500 for headline, Helvetica Neue 15-16px body
type.note: Long text in narrow centred column

thesis: A corporate sustainability page in strict Helvetica, using large bold numerals in grey tiles and image-led link rows.
why_made: Narrow reading column, data tiles and thumbnails list follow one grey and white system with no ornament; clear and trustworthy.
watch_out: Without photography and the numerals the page is a plain document; hero was blank in capture.

name: Warren & Mahoney

type.note: Light grey 'View project' links as secondary

thesis: An architecture studio expressed through blocks of flat colour and a W-shaped photo cut-out, with large 30-60px statements.
why_made: The brand colour blocks (green, red, orange, pink, purple) used as moving shapes behind headlines are specific and ownable; type is one regular grotesk.
watch_out: Image placeholders were grey in capture so photographic payoff is unproven; the colour blocks without images feel like blank Lego.

name: The Aviator

type.display: Hammersmith One, 29px white caps with large wordmark
type.note: Game HUD labels in tiny caps

thesis: A WebGL game start screen with a cartoon plane in a painterly blue sky and two mode buttons.
why_made: Cohesive saturated blue palette, soft lit low-poly clouds and a consistent chunky typeface make a game scene read as one world.
watch_out: It is a game, not a site template; the effects need 3D runtime and have little transferable layout.

name: Origin Wellness Spa

type.note: Serif display over grotesk body

thesis: A calm spa page: light neutrals, a serif headline, rounded photo collage and one dark pill CTA repeated everywhere.
why_made: Restraint in colour and a single repeating CTA shape keep a lot of service content coherent; photography does the emotional work.
watch_out: The serif plus tiny grey body text goes generic without strong photography; the persistent pill and fixed bar can crowd phones.

name: Orbit Design

type.note: Single family, two weights

thesis: A subscription design agency page that sells with product screenshots on pale grey, then one gradient burst with a mascot.
why_made: Single family, large clean white space and real UI shots make it credible; the gradient section is a confident single moment.
watch_out: Without strong portfolio imagery the pale-grey wash reads empty, and the gradient needs the mascot to avoid looking like a template.

name: New Exhibitions

type.note: Black hairlines, one blue accent

thesis: A listings site built as an index: hairline-ruled grid, one grotesk, art images as the only colour, and a single blue for beta and CTAs.
why_made: Every rule and cell is aligned to a visible grid, information density is high but legible, and the images are cropped at natural aspect ratios so the art does the styling.
watch_out: Strip the images and the rules and it is a plain wireframe; sloppy type hierarchy or inconsistent image ratios would break the system.

name: Zumtobel Group

type.text: Neue Haas Unica 14px, Apercu Mono labels
type.note: Huge tracked-tight uppercase

thesis: A corporate lighting group homepage with a full-bleed dusk photograph, uppercase display statements and glass-panel report cards.
why_made: One cinematic photo carries the whole page and the type is a single grotesk at poster scale, with mono labels for the data.
watch_out: White text on a bright sky photo risks contrast loss, and the load shows a white flash and dark frames before content.

name: Clevr Blends

type.note: Italic-ish modern serif with butter and chocolate palette

thesis: A DTC wellness drink store in a butter-yellow and chocolate-brown palette with a soft-focus hero jar.
why_made: The palette is distinctive and food-appropriate, and the serif plus Sohne pairing feels warm yet current; the chocolate footer reveal is a nice ending.
watch_out: Sale banners, pink popups and the yellow gradient bands fight the palette and look cheap when stacked.

name: GiveDirectly

type.note: Dark green donate accent

thesis: A nonprofit with the donation form inside the hero, then evidence told through human portraits and trust marks.
why_made: Real portrait photography at consistent crop, with the donation action always reachable and pale teal bands separating chapters.
watch_out: Dense press-logo and stats sections get template-like; the portraits are what keeps it human.

name: TAYA

type.note: Tight-leaded serif display

thesis: A jewelry launch page built from cinematic video of skin and gold, with serif headlines laid directly on the footage.
why_made: Full-bleed footage graded warm, tight serif headline and a restrained palette make the product feel precious.
watch_out: An email modal on top of every frame hides the work and heavy video would stall on mobile.

name: Framework

type.note: Bold sans with orange accent and pixel mascot

thesis: A hardware store as an editorial series of full-bleed colour chapters: black, lavender, yellow, green, each with one product shot and two buttons.
why_made: Product photography is cut out and arranged precisely on flat colour, headlines and button pairs stay in one system, and the pixel mascot adds personality without breaking order.
watch_out: Flat colour blocks need exact object photography and consistent button pairs; with stock images it reads as a theme template.

name: Essay Gamja

type.note: Potato mascot on lime green

thesis: An MBA admissions consultancy that uses a potato mascot, lime green and a dark results panel to make an expensive decision feel friendly.
why_made: Mascot art is consistently drawn and the dark stats band gives the credibility a counterweight to the cuteness.
watch_out: Mascot-driven tone is wrong for premium or serious briefs and the lime fill gets loud fast.

name: Die PANKOW Zeitmaschine

type.note: Distressed red logo, paper texture

thesis: A band tribute built as a time machine: loading screen that flashes archive footage under a scratched red logo, then a parchment page.
why_made: The loader is the experience: archive clips, grain and red logo set tone before any text, and the paper page follows the same story.
watch_out: Heavy video, grain and distressed type are specific to this subject and would feel wrong or slow elsewhere.

name: The Bakery

type.note: Chunky display with orange and cobalt

thesis: A digital marketing agency in orange, cobalt and big geometric arches and circles with chunky display type.
why_made: Strict two-colour system with geometric shapes cropping photos, so the loudness feels designed rather than random.
watch_out: The saturated colour and shapes only work with a tight two-colour limit; a cookie card on every frame also hurts.

name: Ultrahuman

type.note: Mono JetBrains 12px for labels only

thesis: Warm champagne product photography flips to a black spec section and back to white, with one blue pill CTA as the only saturated colour.
why_made: Single typeface at light weight with tight tracking, rendered product on a tonal sand backdrop, and strict light/dark section alternation give a hardware-brand feel.
watch_out: Without the real titanium render the sand beige hero reads as flat khaki.

name: Wildbran

type.note: One blue pill accent against cream

thesis: A cream editorial snack brand where a full-bleed factory film hero and floating product cutouts carry personality, with one electric-blue pill as the only UI colour.
why_made: Warm cream ground, high-contrast display serif, real photography of people and production, and a single accent make it feel like a premium food brand, not a shop template.
watch_out: The floating product cutouts and giant footer logo need real assets; with stock snack images it turns kitsch.

name: Sonder

type.note: Serif headlines with a copper italic second line

thesis: A booking-first hotel and apartment marketplace in warm paper tones, where a serif headline with copper italic, a navy action colour and dense listing cards stay organised by consistent 8px radii.
why_made: Restrained two-colour system (navy actions, copper emphasis) on warm cream, every card uses the same radius, border and photo ratio, and information-dense listings stay calm.
watch_out: Prata with italic accent and copper cheapens quickly if photography is not editorial; listing density needs strict alignment.

name: Felix Gray

type.note: Chartreuse CTA on deep teal

thesis: Eyewear store using deep teal, cream and a chartreuse CTA with a light serif for headings and portrait photography of real wearers.
why_made: Light serif headings against grotesk body, consistent portrait crops, and one loud CTA colour give it a confident DTC identity.
watch_out: Chartreuse pill CTA and deep teal blocks look cheap without matching photo colour grading.

name: Aesop

type.text: Suisse Int'l 12-14px, Zapf Humanist for quotes
type.note: Quiet cream and ink palette

thesis: Cream paper store where product bottles, editorial photography and a quiet single typeface let the products carry the page.
why_made: Restrained tonal palette, small type, abundant whitespace, and photography consistently framed give a boutique feel.
watch_out: Tiny type with no visual hierarchy fails if product photography is weak.

name: Cafe Vitesse

type.note: Colour blocks as sections

thesis: A cycling cafe and bike shop using colour blocks, bold italic condensed type and large flat cards.
why_made: Saturated colour blocks with consistent card system and bold italic headings hold together strongly.
watch_out: Low-contrast white text on mint and unfinished hero can look broken.

name: Elodie Kimmel

type.display: PP Editorial Old, 56px, 300 mixed with Neue Montreal
type.note: Italic serif first name + grotesk surname

thesis: A soprano's portfolio in pure black with large editorial serif phrases, blurred line-by-line text scrubbing and photo collages.
why_made: Single black ground, a dramatic serif, and imagery appearing as stacked collage tiles make it cinematic and consistent.
watch_out: Hard black pages with scroll-driven text hide content when assets fail to load.

name: Drop Highlight

type.note: Dark with condensed poster headlines

thesis: A dark event-photo platform using condensed poster type, rotated photo walls and product UI mockups.
why_made: Consistent single display face against dark near-black and real event photography keep it cohesive.
watch_out: Anton uppercase everywhere gets shouty and hurts legibility for body copy.

name: Apple iPhone

type.note: Footnote-heavy legal page below

thesis: Product hub with icon-row model switcher, rounded 28px tiles and pill buttons in Apple blue.
why_made: Strict grid, 28px tile radius, system type and generous whitespace make hardware shine.
watch_out: The long legal footnotes dominate the page; copying the tile style without hero photography looks bare.

name: Convex

type.note: VCR mono for labels and consoles, Publico italic 60/60 -1.5px for the pull quote; four families on purpose.

thesis: A backend platform styled like a 1970s racing livery and a CRT terminal, proving devtools need not be black and gradient.
why_made: The retro stripe, warm oxblood and olive blocks, and VCR mono labels form an ownable identity, and the console module is real, usable UI. Each section changes colour outright rather than fading.
watch_out: Four typefaces and six section colours fall apart without one strict label style and a single repeated console component.

name: Lyra

type.display: Rethink Sans 52px/62px 600 with Instrument Serif italic 52px/62px 400
type.note: Every heading breaks into italic serif mid-sentence; numerals use the serif at 60/60.

thesis: Mental healthcare softened by sky-toned photography, huge radii and a sans-to-italic voice that reads human and clinical at once.
why_made: The italic turn in every heading gives a recognisable voice, and photography is unusually warm and well art-directed. Gradient, glass and radius rules repeat consistently down the page.
watch_out: The sans-plus-italic-serif trick and 40px radii have become an AI-template cliche, so it needs real photography to survive.

name: Monzo

type.note: Capture is dimmed by a locale modal scrim, with a blank bar at the bottom of desktop frames, so colours come from measured CSS.

thesis: A consumer bank with hard-coral brand blocks, huge soft radii and warm lifestyle video, confident rather than corporate.
why_made: A custom extra-bold display and a strict coral, navy and mint palette repeat through every module. Rich components like auto-advancing steps and video carousels are built to one geometry.
watch_out: Radii of 64px and 128px with so many pill controls and carousels look childish without custom type and real product UI.

name: Dub Pricing

type.note: Satoshi only for H1 and H2; Inter handles all table and UI text.

thesis: A pricing page built like product UI, with a hairline-framed column and component-level care in every toggle and row.
why_made: Everything shares an 8px and 12px radius scale, and one black button among outlines states the recommended plan. Small product colour chips carry brand through otherwise grey data.
watch_out: Dotted-underline tooltips on nearly every row add noise, and copying them turns a tidy table into a wall of links.

name: Resend Changelog

type.text: Inter 18px/~27px; ABC Favorit 36px/54px -1.8px for entry titles
type.note: Three families with strict jobs: serif only as image-like display, Favorit for entry titles, Inter for everything readable.

thesis: A release log treated as a dated gallery, where every small API change gets a monochrome poster on a pure black timeline.
why_made: Every entry uses the same cover size, type order and spacing across a 70,000px page, and colour is removed entirely so the serif and the chrome renders carry the mood. Only hairlines separate surfaces.
watch_out: Without bespoke per-entry render art the black covers collapse into empty dark rectangles with a serif title.

name: Stripe Climate

type.note: H2s drop to 38px/48px -0.2px. One family carries everything, with colour rather than weight marking links.

thesis: A long, sourced argument for carbon removal presented with the rigour of a Stripe API page and one living green-to-orange gradient.
why_made: Everything hangs on a visible four-column dashed grid, charts are hand-annotated with leader lines, and shadows, angles and colour all repeat one system. Citations and reviewer lists get the same care as the hero.
watch_out: Copying the angled gradient and big shadows without the grid discipline and real data produces a 2019 SaaS template.

name: Perplexity

type.note: Ink is a very dark teal rather than black; alpha steps of it provide all greys.

thesis: The homepage is the product: a single composer on a quiet off-white canvas with the sidebar as its only navigation.
why_made: Teal-tinted ink and 3.5% to 7% alpha fills produce a very controlled tonal range. Empty states, tooltips and small mode controls feel considered despite very little on screen.
watch_out: A centred input with a sidebar is the default AI app shell, so without ink colour and fine control detail it looks generic.

name: Are.na

type.note: No type above 19.2px at all. Hierarchy is bold, position and whitespace only.

thesis: A product page written as a plain document, trusting a custom typeface, honest copy and live demos of the tool.
why_made: Rejecting display scale entirely is a brave decision that matches the anti-algorithm product. The animated walkthroughs are real UI, and the small details such as colophon and day counter feel personally made.
watch_out: Without a custom typeface and distinctive writing, one-size text on white reads as an unstyled page.

name: Penpot

type.note: Tracking is visibly open for a display size, which reads friendly but a little dated.

thesis: A design tool sold by showing the tool, with looping editor recordings and its own canvas UI borrowed as page decoration.
why_made: Dark high-fidelity editor footage contrasts well with the pale page, and the selection-box heading is a clever use of product language. Motion shows collaboration instead of describing it.
watch_out: Work Sans at 72px with open tracking plus teal buttons drifts toward a 2020 template unless the product footage carries the page.

name: Brex

type.note: Headings look tighter than measured; section H2s 48/48 -0.96px. Flecha serif appears only in the testimonial quote.

thesis: Enterprise fintech made sharp through tight Inter, one vermilion accent and small fabricated UI fragments.
why_made: A single orange is rationed to CTAs, links and key numbers, and the mini UI cards are redrawn for clarity rather than screenshotted. Grey band sections pace a long page.
watch_out: The generated-looking portraits and generic layout mean that without the crisp UI fragments it would be any Inter SaaS page.

name: ElevenLabs Pricing

type.note: A light-weight display at only 48px does the luxury work. Section heads stay 36px/42px weight 300.

thesis: A dense pricing page calmed by a ruled paper-like grid, warm neutrals and exactly one grainy colour field.
why_made: Solid hairlines hold structure while dotted rules hold rows, so a huge amount of data stays quiet. The single grain gradient on the recommended plan does all the selling on an otherwise colourless page.
watch_out: Add a second gradient tile or heavier type and the restraint that gives the coloured card its power disappears.

name: OpenAI API Pricing

type.note: One custom family; size and black-versus-60%-black carry the hierarchy.

thesis: A strictly monochrome price sheet that lets custom type and four starfield headers stand in for brand.
why_made: The page is nearly all alpha-black fills on white, with very consistent pills and a single image motif across cards. It answers one question quickly and then stops.
watch_out: Plain cards on white need a custom typeface; set in a default font this page becomes a bare table.

name: Make Town

type.display: PP Frama Black, 318px, 900, normal tracking, lh 238px
type.note: Only four sizes on the page: 12, 14, 28 and 318. All colour comes from the photographs.

thesis: A closing letter from a craft studio, set as one enormous black thank-you between warm documentary photographs.
why_made: The jump from 14px letter text to a 318px ultra-black word is carried through without any middle sizes. The photography is strong enough that the page needs no other decoration.
watch_out: Giant ultra-black type with stock or weak photos stops being heartfelt and turns into a loud template.

name: Supabase Launch Week

type.text: SuisseIntl-Book, 16px/24px; Manrope for card titles and section labels
type.note: Green appears only in the logo and one nav button; the campaign itself is strictly black and white.

thesis: A launch-week index built from one idea: a 1-bit dithered galaxy and big plain Swiss type on white.
why_made: A single image treatment runs across masthead, cards, slices and globe, so a simple index feels like an authored campaign. The grid stays strictly inside the 1088px column.
watch_out: Dither over small card text gets noisy fast, and without a tight column the white page just looks empty.

name: Monark Markets

type.note: Only four sizes: 12, 14, 15 and 75. The film carries everything between.

thesis: A one-film fintech page: a headline, a two-minute brand video and regulated fine print.
why_made: It commits to one piece of content and frames it carefully, with a restrained navy field and an unusually good logo strip. The strict type scale keeps it institutional.
watch_out: Without a film of this quality the page is only a headline and a compliance paragraph.

name: Nuxt

type.note: Outfit on headings only, tracked -2.5%. Inter handles all UI and body.

thesis: A framework homepage that stays useful: real code, real numbers and one green accent on near-black.
why_made: Strict neutral greys and one radius family keep a long, dense page calm, and the small tables and sponsor grid are treated as carefully as the hero.
watch_out: Green-on-black with Inter is the default devtool look, so without real content it reads as a template.

name: Airpost: The Frontier Marketing OS for Frontier Companies

type.text: Host Grotesk 20px/28px; Instrument Sans for small UI
type.note: Display steps 112, 88, 72, 64, 56 all keep -3% tracking; word spacing reads visibly wide.

thesis: A pure-black AI marketing page where huge regular-weight sentences alternate with simulated product UI.
why_made: The product fragments are bespoke and animated rather than screenshots, and regular-weight display type gives calm scale. One blue does every job.
watch_out: Black pages with blue glow are everywhere in AI, so the look collapses without custom UI fragments like these.

name: Trigger.dev

type.text: Geist 16-18px/24-28px; Geist Mono for labels and diagrams
type.note: Three families with clear jobs: Satoshi headings, Geist body, Geist Mono for anything machine-made.

thesis: A devtool page drawn as a technical ledger: a hairline frame full of small, purpose-drawn diagrams of how the product behaves.
why_made: Nearly every section has a custom animated diagram that explains a concept, and the column frame binds them. A faint frame line crossing a closing headline is its one visible flaw.
watch_out: Copy the rails and neon lime without bespoke diagrams and it becomes a generic dark devtool grid.

name: Grafana

type.note: Poppins semibold is heavy and friendly; Inter takes all body and nav.

thesis: A large enterprise homepage that keeps a friendly pastel face while packing in many product and proof sections.
why_made: The hero handles several audiences well through labelled CTAs and an AI input, and the tinted screenshot trays are consistent. It is competent rather than refined, and busy.
watch_out: Poppins plus pastel gradient reads dated quickly, and a sticky promo bar eating 15 percent of the viewport cheapens everything.

name: Stripe Billing

type.display: sohne-var, 48px for numerals, 32px for headlines, 300, -0.02em, lh 1.03-1.1
type.text: sohne-var, 16px/22px at weight 300-400; 8-12px inside UI mocks
type.note: No bold anywhere. The hero headline is only 32px; hierarchy comes from two-tone sentences, not scale. Radii stay at 4-6px.

thesis: An enterprise product page that earns trust through restraint: small light type, hairline structure and one vivid gradient behind exact product UI.
why_made: Every section hangs off the same two rails and a 4-6px radius system, and the UI mocks are complete enough to read at 9px. The single gradient gives life without touching the type.
watch_out: 32px light headlines only work with exact rules, spacing and real UI; with placeholder mocks the page looks timid and empty.

name: Ghostty

type.display: No display type; JetBrains Mono 10px ASCII is the image
type.note: Largest text on the page is 16px.

thesis: A terminal emulator's homepage that is simply a terminal window playing an ASCII animation of its mascot.
why_made: It shows the product's medium instead of describing it, and removes everything else. The window chrome and two buttons are exact and quiet.
watch_out: Works only for a product whose medium is text; a page this bare elsewhere reads as unfinished.

name: Affirm

type.note: Calibre runs small, so body is set larger than usual. Display stays light at every size from 48 to 80.

thesis: A consumer lending page made to feel premium: violet-black glass, thin geometric type and products lit like jewellery.
why_made: A single logo-derived periwinkle light runs through card strokes, glows and the footer arc, with strict 24px radii and one white pill as the only CTA. Depth comes from stacking and light, not clutter.
watch_out: Gradient borders and glass turn into crypto-template noise if the stroke is brighter than 1px or if glows leave the cards.

name: PostHog Pricing

type.note: One family for everything; pale sage window chrome carries the colour.

thesis: A pricing page presented as a retro desktop operating system on a grassy wallpaper, full of deadpan jokes.
why_made: The metaphor is pushed all the way through icons, windows, boxed software and parody e-commerce, while the calculator underneath stays properly useful. Voice and design agree.
watch_out: Skeuomorphic OS chrome without real wit and working tools is just clutter, and it is wrong for most brands.

name: Vapi

type.note: Tracking is extreme: -5% at 80px, -5.8% at 40px. Gridnik supplies the machine voice.

thesis: A voice-AI page that opens with abstract motion footage and a live call control, then settles into disciplined white and black bands.
why_made: The tracked-tight avantt plus Gridnik labels give a distinct voice, and the phone number band is a clever brand-native CTA. Lower sections are tidier than they are special.
watch_out: Tracking this tight turns headings muddy if the font lacks the right weight or if the size drops below 40px.

name: Evenark

type.note: One family at weight 300 and a jump from 14 to 44. Sections read as large plain sentences.

thesis: A studio site that trusts one motion-blurred photograph and large light sentences, then hands the page over to its case work.
why_made: Large light type on warm paper with tiny labels gives a confident editorial tempo, and the case tiles have real variety. The 44px difference-blend nav colliding with content in frames holds it out of top tier.
watch_out: A fixed 44px nav over content causes constant text collisions; the idea needs a clear zone or a hide-on-scroll.

name: UploadThing

type.note: ui-monospace appears only for eyebrows, attribution and the price footnote, always small and often red.

thesis: A short developer pitch that alternates red-tinted black with cool white and makes the second line of every key headline the punchline.
why_made: Black carries a real red cast instead of pure #000, and red is rationed to one word group plus the CTA. Curved seams between sections give a plain layout one memorable shape.
watch_out: Saturated red on near-black with a bloom behind it reads as a gaming template the moment the red spreads past headlines and buttons.

name: Svelte

type.note: Fira Sans handles nav and UI. All display copy is lowercase, which sets a friendly voice for a developer tool.

thesis: An open-source framework behaves like a warm personal homepage: a toy-factory render, a dictionary entry and a lot of community faces.
why_made: The conveyor render literally explains what a compiler does. Bold lowercase serif plus Georgia body resists the dark devtool default completely.
watch_out: Tilted photo piles and Georgia body feel like a 2012 blog without a render of this quality anchoring the page.

name: SpaceX

type.note: Display is caps with positive tracking and line height under 1; 48px for chapter headings, 13px tracked caps for nav.

thesis: Six full-screen mission photographs in a row, each carrying one caps statement and one ghost button.
why_made: Photography is cropped so the negative space always holds the copy, and the UI vocabulary stays one font and one button throughout.
watch_out: With ordinary imagery this one-photo-one-headline formula is a template, and its hairline ghost button vanishes on bright skies without a scrim.

name: Vite

type.note: KH Teka Mono for code, labels and handles. -5% tracking on a wide grotesk is the signature; 48px for section heads.

thesis: A dark devtool page built as one continuous hairline frame, with a single purple grain material and an isometric diagram language explaining the product.
why_made: There are no cards: every block is a cell in a page-wide grid of 1px rules with diamond nodes at junctions. Purple is restricted to one textured material, so it reads as a substance and not as a gradient.
watch_out: Violet on near-black is the most over-used devtool look; without grain, the hairline frame and bespoke diagrams it collapses into a stock template.

name: Hibachi Guru

type.note: Host Grotesk for lead lines and Inter in lists: too many sans faces, held together by Anton caps everywhere.

thesis: A catering service sold like a gig poster: loud condensed caps, fire-lit video and a quote form never far away.
why_made: Anton at huge sizes gives one instantly recognisable voice, and the red pill CTA recurs after every section so the page always knows its job.
watch_out: White display type collides with bright photos, a widget watermark shows, and a long SEO copy wall ends the page; this loudness needs scrims and editing to stay professional.

name: Berries

type.note: Script wordmark is the only character type. Section heads are Lato bold at 48px with tight tracking.

thesis: A clinical AI note tool that avoids robot imagery and opens on a calm line drawing of a therapist's room.
why_made: The hero illustration is drawn for this audience and uses a floor line that the page's grey band picks up, giving a soft start to a compliance-heavy product.
watch_out: Lato with tight tracking, boxy blue glow buttons and stock Merriweather is what makes the lower page feel templated; only the illustration carries the brand.

name: Zed Blog

type.note: Nothing but the title reaches 28px. Duospace carries nav, list and body; ui-monospace and zedMono cover 10-12px metadata.

thesis: A blog index drawn like a technical blueprint on paper, where a single ledger of every post is the whole design.
why_made: Construction lines, hatching and tiny nodes are visible but so faint they read as paper grain, and the only saturated colour is held back for one button and a blue footer slab. Density feels edited, not crowded.
watch_out: Raise the grid or hatch above ~8% contrast, or add more accent colours, and the blueprint becomes decoration that competes with the list.

name: Better Auth

type.note: Geist Mono is nearly equal in volume, at 11-13px for labels, numbers and tags. No type above 36px.

thesis: The landing page behaves like a repository: a fixed title panel on the left and a scrolling README on the right.
why_made: One conceit decides everything: tabbed nav, numbered features, mono labels and table cells all follow the README idea. Colour appears only inside tiny product chips, so a greyscale page feels alive.
watch_out: At 11-13px across dense cells this is only legible with perfect spacing; loosen the alignment and it becomes a cluttered spec sheet.

name: Substack

type.note: -apple-system-ui-serif italic 400 swaps in for one word per headline, which is the type signature.

thesis: The homepage skips the marketing page and shows the live feed itself, led by one orange pitch card.
why_made: Real posts in masonry prove the product better than any feature grid, and orange is confined to one card, one button and small flourishes, so the feed's colour can vary.
watch_out: Relying on user content means no control of tone; without strict card rhythm and quiet chrome, it turns into a noisy aggregator.

name: Groq

type.note: Only three sizes exist: 16, 50, 135px. komuna, a pixel-edged mono, handles 16px nav and labels.

thesis: An AI infrastructure company replaces its homepage with a scrolling manifesto that darkens word by word, edged by orange silicon pixels.
why_made: A three-size type scale and two custom fonts mean every decision is visible. Pixel chips tie to the logo splash, so decoration has an origin.
watch_out: Without a product picture this is a statement page, and a manifesto with ordinary writing or stock fonts would be an empty scroll.

name: Anthropic Docs

type.note: anthropicMono in code. One large light serif per page; section heads are 22px sans.

thesis: A docs home that reads as a calm index of link tiles on warm paper, with a code sample given the same weight as the headline.
why_made: Borders, radii and label sizes are absolutely consistent, and hand-inked icons bring warmth where other docs use gradients.
watch_out: With every block a bordered tile, the page flattens into one texture; it needs the serif and colour-banded model cards to avoid looking like a link farm.

name: Better Stack

type.note: Display carries a white-to-lavender gradient fill; body has slightly open tracking on dark.

thesis: A long dark product tour where each product line gets a heading and a horizontal rail of dimmed UI cards.
why_made: Product UI is real and carefully dimmed, with one lit element per card. A blue-black ladder keeps nine product sections from feeling repetitive.
watch_out: UI dimmed this far borders on unreadable, and the same rail repeated nine times feels endless without strong product demos.

name: Readwise

type.note: Inter for app chrome and Source Serif inside quote cards, matching the reading product.

thesis: A warm reading-app page where the highlighter is the design device, applied across gradient panels and paper-toned screens.
why_made: Yellow marker spans enact what the product does, and decorations are built from real quote cards. Everything sits in big radius panels on cream, so the warmth feels bookish.
watch_out: Peach gradients plus 30px radii drift quickly into friendly-SaaS sameness without the serif, the marker and real product objects.

name: Loom

type.note: Sizes scale from root; Display is tight and heavy, Text has generous letter-spacing and leading.

thesis: A friendly enterprise page built from oversized rounded slabs of brand blue and a recurring webcam bubble.
why_made: Huge 69px corners on full-width blue and black slabs give a soft brand shape, and the circle-cam motif appears in every screen, keeping the product present.
watch_out: Pastel cards, huge radii and pill buttons add up to a generic corporate-friendly look when the imagery is not bespoke.

name: Greylock

type.note: H2 81/72.9 at -3% tracking; condensed Trade Gothic at 16px for nav and 13px uppercase for labels and captions.

thesis: A venture firm staged as an unmapped chart: hairline rails, vanishing-point grids and stippled coastlines carry one idea while a light serif and one saturated blue do the speaking.
why_made: Every line from nav to footer canvas belongs to the same cartographic system, and colour is rationed to #003399 on selected phrases. Candid founder photos sit hard against the rails with no radii.
watch_out: The map motif becomes wallpaper if rails, stipple and rays rise above near-invisible contrast or the serif is set heavier than 300.

name: Vayne Entertainment

type.note: All headings uppercase; H2 40/48 at 500; nav also in condensed caps at ~20px.

thesis: A drag and events agency staged as a red-lit theatre, where portraits, grain and condensed caps do the performing.
why_made: The monochrome oxblood palette ties wildly different photography together, and black-and-white images rest the eye between red moments. Antonio caps give a poster voice that suits the talent.
watch_out: Red overlay and heavy grain can swallow text, and tight Antonio caps read cheap outside nightlife or theatrical briefs.

name: Sweeply

type.note: Display caps out at 48px; 28px serif for list items; Circular Medium for labels.

thesis: Hotel operations software softened by a grainy coral-to-yellow ribbon lifted straight from its logo.
why_made: One signature shape, the logo swoosh scaled up with grain, threads behind every section while UI and type stay neutral. Tight serif display warms an otherwise plain white SaaS page.
watch_out: A blurred gradient ribbon is a common trope; without the grain, the logo link and neutrals elsewhere it turns into a generic startup page.

name: Diego's Authentic Foods

type.note: Italic words at the same size inside roman lines; Biro Script for handwritten notes; Inter only in nav.

thesis: A B2B tortilla maker given the warmth of a family scrapbook: ultralight serif, typewriter mono, biro scribbles, stickers and loud flat colour.
why_made: Three voices stay consistent across 15,000px, and hand-drawn annotations are placed with care. Real family photographs keep the whimsy honest.
watch_out: Neon green, hot pink and a taco cursor overwhelm fast; without the disciplined serif scale and white space it becomes a novelty template.

name: Stripe Connect

type.note: H2 38/48 -0.2px, H3 26/36, small copy 15/24, weight 425 on buttons; Source Code Pro in code panels.

thesis: A dense platform-payments page held together by one visible five-line column grid, with real product fragments doing the persuading.
why_made: Every element snaps to exposed dashed guides, type stays within a few sizes of Sohne, and product mocks are rebuilt in HTML with believable data. Layered blue-tinted shadows give depth with no noticeable borders.
watch_out: Exposed guides and big shadows look like wireframe debris if content does not truly align to them or mocks are placeholder shapes.

name: Customer.io

type.note: One family throughout. H2 40/45, closers 64/64. Nothing exceeds weight 475 apart from small titles, and tracking stays slightly positive.

thesis: An enterprise marketing platform dressed in one deep teal, with huge unbolded type, hairline boxes and chamfered portraits as its signature.
why_made: Weight stays at 475 even at 96px, so scale gives authority without shouting, and the ruled layout avoids card shadows. Accent colour is rationed by role: mint for action, ochre for labels, one tint per customer story.
watch_out: Thin hairline boxes and low-weight display type collapse into a wireframe if the type scale is timid or the teal is swapped for black.

name: Therabody

type.note: Serif at 48/53 and 36/40 for section heads and card titles, with occasional italic words; Suisse with tight tracking for commerce copy.

thesis: Clinical wellness hardware retailed through a warm-cream serif system that reads more like a magazine than a gadget store.
why_made: Close cream tones stack surfaces without borders, and the medium-weight serif carries warmth over dense commerce copy. Evidence is built in, with stats and footnotes attached directly to cards.
watch_out: Too many full-width black buttons and stacked promos become a generic Shopify template if the cream ladder and photography slip.

name: Herzog & de Meuron

type.note: No display size exists: hierarchy comes from the heavy black logo against light mono at 16-23px.

thesis: An architecture archive presented as a searchable index: black mono captions, tag pills and uncropped images on pure white.
why_made: One type voice, a five-column grid and no chrome keep attention on the photographs, and varied image ratios create rhythm without changing the grid. Tags and search replace hero marketing entirely.
watch_out: Centred mono captions read as unfinished while images lazy-load grey, and the unbacked fixed logo collides with content passing beneath.

name: Plausible Live Dashboard

type.note: Dashboard figures ~18px bold; labels 12px uppercase medium with slight tracking. Tailwind zinc neutrals.

thesis: A live product page that is simply the real analytics dashboard, public and data dense, with one closing pitch.
why_made: Disciplined neutrals and a strict table rhythm let numbers read at a glance, and tinted bars behind rows replace chart clutter. The page sells by being the product.
watch_out: System-font dashboards look bare without genuine data and spacing discipline, and the pastel bars look random without a clear per-panel colour rule.

name: Canary

type.note: Rounded display echoes the wordmark; Manrope with slight negative tracking for everything else.

thesis: A dry tax-credit product made approachable with a sunglasses chick mascot, rounded type and one yellow.
why_made: Mascot, logo bird and CTA share one hue, and the oversized footer wordmark gives a strong brand ending. Product tiles show legible cropped UI rather than abstract shapes.
watch_out: Quicksand and a cartoon mascot can feel juvenile for a compliance product, and repeated pills and cards sit close to template.

name: GoCardless

type.note: Serif wordmark logo is the only serif; H2 ~36px Haffer; stat numerals 42/50 Inter bold.

thesis: Bank payment infrastructure pitched through a tidy blue-grey product system, with a serif wordmark and electric yellow as the only loud notes.
why_made: Cards separate by a one-step tint rather than shadow, and crisp bespoke UI fragments give the page substance. Yellow on deep navy supplies the only real colour contrast.
watch_out: Near-white cards on near-white ground vanish on poor screens, and repeated identical grids become a template without custom UI fragments.

name: Betterment

type.note: Serif numerals run up to 154px; H2 48/48; GT America 500 for labels and buttons.

thesis: Personal finance sold as warm daylight: blue sky gradients, cream paper and a friendly soft serif, with phones in real hands.
why_made: Sky colour flows from the hero photo through section gradients into cream, so the palette feels photographed rather than picked. Hard right-edge shadows give cards a tactile, ownable thickness.
watch_out: Yellow CTAs, check bullets, banknote art and stock family photos tip into fintech ad material without strict type and colour control.

name: Together AI

type.note: PP Neue Montreal Mono at 11-14px uppercase for buttons, tags and labels; second headline line at ~40% black.

thesis: An AI cloud framed as a research lab: geometric sans for ambition, uppercase mono for engineering, and a lilac connector motif running through nav and cards.
why_made: The connector bar carries from the nav into the research cards, and the 4px radius and mono labels repeat everywhere. Grey secondary buttons and a stock-feeling render keep it below top tier.
watch_out: Uppercase mono buttons and glossy 3D abstraction are common AI-cloud defaults and read as a template without an owned motif.

name: axem

type.note: H2s 45px/49.5px at 400; no radii anywhere on the page.

thesis: Defence-grade AI infrastructure sold through saturated grain art inside a strict black ruled frame, more poster than SaaS page.
why_made: One stipple treatment unifies all the art, and a 1200px hairline frame with zero radii holds it in place. Custom pixel chevrons give even small buttons a signature.
watch_out: White labels on busy iridescent tiles lose legibility, and grain gradients without the strict frame turn into generic AI wallpaper.

name: Linear Changelog

type.note: Entry titles 32px/36px 590 at -0.704px; body #d0d6e0; Berkeley Mono only for small technical labels.

thesis: A product changelog treated as a long-read document: one column, a date rail, and near-black surfaces that let shipped UI crops carry the page.
why_made: Every value is disciplined: 17px/27px body, 624px measure, hairlines at 6-8% white, one orange dot as the only accent. Product figures are masked into the page rather than pasted on.
watch_out: Without real product crops and this restraint in tracking and grey steps, it collapses into a plain dark blog.

name: Sword Health

type.note: H2s 58px/64px; Lora also sets numerals; Figtree handles all UI.

thesis: Clinical AI care softened with a sunset haze, a literary serif and human photography so software feels like healthcare.
why_made: A 32px radius and warm #f7f4f2 ground hold a very long page together, and the partial gradient stroke on device frames is a small owned detail.
watch_out: Lora over pastel gradients with 32px cards slides into wellness-template territory when the photos and device work are weaker.

name: Hugging Face

type.note: H2s 30px/36px; IBM Plex Mono for repository names; dark panels #0b0f19.

thesis: A community hub that markets itself with its own product surface: real model rows, real org cards and a hugging mascot instead of abstract art.
why_made: Real data components stand in for marketing graphics, and the skewed index panel gives dense UI presence. The mascot pile is a memorable end note.
watch_out: Source Sans bold headlines and dense emoji-laced rows look dated and cluttered without the real data and community goodwill behind them.

name: Wispr Flow

type.note: Measured 96px/91.2px and 120px/102px; turning phrases set in italic. Lilac #f0d7ff marks the action.

thesis: A voice app that sells speech as writing: literary Garamond, cream paper and motion-blurred footage instead of AI gradients and app screenshots.
why_made: Roman-to-italic headlines, rounded colour sheets and one lilac action run through every section. Each section invents a demo that explains the feature, such as panel width standing for typing speed.
watch_out: The 2px ink button and skewed colour testimonial cards tip into novelty without this much restraint around them; the consent panel in these frames is a capture artefact, not a design to copy.

name: Tana

type.note: Serif only for headlines and pull quotes; Inter carries UI, 24px/400 titles and #3a3a3a body.

thesis: A meeting tool pitched in calm serif-and-Inter light, where dark product windows and warm prism-lit photos supply all the drama.
why_made: Type is held to two steps, 52px serif and 17-19px Inter, and every section resolves on the same 1316px edge. Chips, hairlines and black controls repeat exactly, and the photography has an owned look.
watch_out: Swap the art-directed prism photos for stock and the page becomes a plain serif-on-white SaaS template.

name: Brett Jackson

type.note: Geist Mono 16px/17.6px 500 for caps labels; Gambetta italic used once as a sign-off.

thesis: A one-column personal page with almost no imagery, relying on two grey tones, a mono label and dashed rules.
why_made: Two text colours do all the hierarchy, and dashed rails give a plain document a sense of construction. There is little on the page, and nothing is off.
watch_out: Copy does all the work; with weak writing or default spacing this layout is an unstyled text file.

name: Lindy

type.note: H2s 56px/58.8px; closing phrase of each heading set in a gold gradient.

thesis: An AI employee sold like a friendly colleague: warm off-white, blue actions, gold highlights and a line-drawn mascot narrating the page.
why_made: Believable chat and schedule UI shows the agent at work, and amber links headlines, quotes and ticks. Spacing and card details stay consistent all the way through pricing.
watch_out: Gold gradient text and arcs of floating tool icons are common AI-startup tropes that look cheap if the UI beneath is not this carefully built.

name: Relume

type.note: Mono caps eyebrows in magenta; product mock uses ABC Diatype Semi-Mono at 103px.

thesis: A site builder that turns its own building blocks into the brand: voxels, pixel edges and a magenta prompt that follows you down the page.
why_made: The block unit appears at every scale, from hero masses to lettering, and the prompt dock keeps one action alive. Section layouts stay strict so colour can be loud.
watch_out: Magenta, yellow voxels and pink grids are only held up by rigid layout; loosen it and the page looks like a toy.

name: Oatly

type.display: Hand-cut poster caps in artwork, ~150px; live H1 Margo Pro 29.9px uppercase
type.note: Largest live text is 32px; the hero headline is part of the image. Tags in pink #f8c8d8, amber #fdcf85, grey #c6c6c6, blue #98c5d3.

thesis: A brand that behaves like a stubborn piece of office software: a ruled window on graph paper, filled with loud zine-like campaign work.
why_made: The frame concept is applied to everything, including footer, tags and popups. Hand-cut type and flash photography are unmistakably Oatly's own.
watch_out: Hard shadows and ruled boxes without a real brand voice and campaign art become stock neo-brutalism.

name: One Medical

type.note: Hero headline ~72px in bright blue; later headings 72-88px in #005450.

thesis: Primary care presented as a warm consumer brand through a strong serif, deep green and hand-painted spots.
why_made: Serif, green and butter pill form a clear brand system, and the illustration set is original. The layout itself is older and simpler than top-tier work.
watch_out: Centred text blocks and small link-under-text grids date quickly, and the capture measured horizontal overflow on phone.

name: Cloudflare Docs

type.note: JetBrains Mono carries code and the orange uppercase category tags. Section heads ~30px, 500.

thesis: A documentation home that works like a product landing page while staying inside the docs shell of sidebar, search and hairline cells.
why_made: A strict hairline cell grid with crop-mark corners gives a drafting-table feel, and one orange is rationed to the primary action, the tab underline and small tags.
watch_out: Crop-mark squares and mono tags turn to noise if they land on every box rather than only the main frames.

name: Vitsoe

type.note: Only 14, 16, 17 and 32px exist. Bold blue marks links; regular weight carries everything else; there is no display scale.
